releases.displayName: Update Notes 6/12: Season 8 "Myriad Souls" available now!

items.text: Hello everyone!

This update marks the start of Season 8 "Myriad Souls", and Season 7 "Rune Secrets" will conclude simultaneously. Additionally, this update expands the Act 4 area \[Crystal Vale], adds a batch of Occult Scrolls and Weapon Inscriptions, and adjusts the performance of 3 weapons. We hope you enjoy the game!
--- Gunfire Reborn Studio
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1217060/_/"]

Souls flow in myriad forms. Through mysterious arts from distant realms, one can absorb the essence of great demons and comprehend the power of souls. Inlaying Soul Jades reveals even more wonders. To uncover these mysteries, adventurers have embarked on expeditions. However, many monsters have also been nurtured by these souls and now await the arrival of explorers... [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/32e3cde384078b20edbda4813ebcec5c9bb90ce4.png"]

Like previous Seasons, "Myriad Souls" is only available in Nightmare and Reincarnation difficulties. During the adventure, players can obtain various Soul Pendants and Soul Jades, creating different buff effects through strategic combinations. At the same time, players will need to challenge enemies strengthened by demon souls.
Detailed gameplay rules can be previewed in the in-game Season interface.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/43184eedc8a4dd046bb457716610a4b93062072e.gif"]

Complete season tasks, raise your season level, and unlock the "Myriad Souls" avatar frame, season-exclusive spray pack, the "Butterfly Dream" skin for Angelic Aura, the "Abyssal Dragon" skin for Dragon Breath, as well as emoticons, avatars, and other seasonal rewards

releases.displayName: Tavern Chat #018: Season 8 Update Preview, New Stage & New Enemies!

items.text: Hello everyone!
The development of the new Season is halfway done. In this issue of Tavern Chat, let's step into another corner of \[Hyperborean Jokul] and enjoy a different scenery...

In \[Hyperborean Jokul], Crown Prince stepped onto the snowy path, moving forward as usual, when suddenly a strange light flashed somewhere. Holding his breath to look closely, he surprisingly discovered a flow of light hidden behind the snow wall by the roadside. Breaking through the wall and venturing deeper, a brand new picture slowly unfolded—twilight snow dancing, the cold wind howling, behind the curtain woven by auroras, mystery and wonder are quietly waiting for explorers to discover...
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/fc5715000822fc10b8ffc0e83070a8016d390735.gif"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/9415b011a5d549864ab4dcf4142a43d85c627a2a.gif"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/6a52d4e9986ee2a38df62c7ddeed43350a55c588.gif"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/1579fdc6857a53c5b3aee6b57a273276f2a53b0f.gif"]

In the new Season, we will expand the Act 4 map. At that time, new routes for Stage 4-1 and Stage 4-2 will be added. The terrain of the areas will be more diverse, providing more possibilities for combat. But at the same time, new enemies will also follow.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/91a7119c34a42be89cb82d57ab5be01d87329689.gif"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/1d73043e33d93f3a03cc43eecfad22a7e28d775f.gif"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/86a896290cf0f745261a95f877c5ac718427a5f5.gif"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/b65760ccd0d22e4e1aaa67c531417d69e8d13045.gif"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/bca29a73d465a880315fe328c1d8d27965504b28.gif"]
In terms of enemies, more agile and powerful enemies will join the battle.
To satisfy more combat imagination and enrich build possibilities, we will add a batch of brand new Occult Scrolls.
\[Fortune's Favor]

Occasional deviation from the plan with the Ascension given by Golden Goblet? Don't worry, \[Fortune's Favor] will grant extra Ascension refresh chances, making the Golden Goblet reward more satisfying.
\[Shadow Step]
Teammates running too fast to catch up? When needing to chase the player with the highest Movement Speed, \[Shadow Step] will provide a Movement Speed bonus, ensuring you can fight side by side.
\[Wondrous Chest]
This is a surprise gift with multiple possibilities! \[Wondrous Chest] will offer multiple Occult Scrolls to choose from, allowing you to pick the most desired Occult Scroll according to your needs.
Don't want the Occult Scroll rewarded by the Chest? \ has the ability to refresh Occult Scrolls, providing the surprise of turning waste into treasure.
We will add a batch of new Inscriptions, providing richer possibilities for Weapon usage.
Special thanks to the following players for your contributions to game text optimization:
R4ylot (German)
ももやす (Japanese)
Following our tradition, the players mentioned above can go to the official Gunfire Reborn Discord community and contact the community admin to claim the exclusive role—a little gift from Zi Xiao!!
Text Validation Mode Introduction

\[Text Validation] is now available in-game, and you can turn it On in Settings. When encountering text issues such as unclear meaning, stiff translation, or typos, you can submit modification suggestions at any time. We will continue to adopt suitable proposals and thank contributing players in subsequent #Tavern Chat.
Welcome to participate in the localization co-creation of Gunfire Reborn and improve the localization quality of the game with us!

According to the current Development Progression, the Season 8 update will be released in mid-June. We will announce more development information in the next Tavern Chat, including the new Season, Weapon adjustments, etc. Please stay tuned.
--- Gunfire Reborn Studio

releases.displayName: Update Notes 2/5: Season 7 "Rune Secrets" is Now Live!

items.text: What's up, folks!

This update marks the start of Season 7, "Rune Secrets", and will simultaneously conclude Season 6, "Fortune's Roll". Additionally, this update expands the Act 1 area \[Silent Crypt], optimizes the experience for the Hero \, adds new weapons \[Cloud Edge] and \, and adjusts the performance of 4 other weapons. Hope you enjoy it!
--- Gunfire Reborn Studio
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/456d8b7654e958b79bb81710f9ec2504eae03257.png"]

Mystic runes form hallowed arrays, weaving extraordinary causes and effects. Mysterious Rune Stones infused with uncanny power have quietly emerged across the realm. By mastering the secrets of their formation, one can unlock their hidden potential and overcome any obstacle. To pursue this path, heroes have set off on new expeditions. Yet, treasures are often guarded by peril—monsters nurtured by these stones will be the greatest hurdles on your journey...

Like previous Seasons, "Rune Secrets" is only available in Nightmare and Reincarnation Difficulties. During your adventures, you can obtain various Rune Stones and Runic Energy. By arranging them appropriately, you can activate abilities with distinct characteristics—but be prepared to face enemies empowered by Rune Stones as well!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/c4c9ec4bc64f087e7873a340d7fb16cf7eb343cd.gif"]
Complete Seasonal Missions and raise your Season Level to unlock exclusive rewards：
Avatar Frame: "Rune Secrets"
Spray Packs: "Prank Spray Pack" and "New Year Spray Pack"
Frenzied Shark Weapon Skin: "Rainbow Candy"
Goshawk Weapon Skin: "Eye of Horus"

Some Spiritual Goblets in Spiritual Assault will also be adjusted. We hope these changes bring you a more diverse and enjoyable experience.

releases.displayName: Tavern Chat #014: Season 7 Update Preview – New Stages & New Enemies!

items.text: What's up, folks!
Development on the new season is now halfway done! In this #Tavern Chat#, we're diving deeper into the
\[Longling Tomb] to uncover the secrets hidden within...

In \[Longling Tomb], while making usual run through the ancient depths, Crown Prince spotted something unusual—a statue glowing with a faint violet light. After investigating the dim shadows, he found a concealed door. Beyond it lies a forgotten section of the tomb: overgrown ruins tangled in ancient vines,
bathed in a cold, eerie glow. These long-lost chambers hold both hidden dangers and ancient treasures...
Now it's finally time to discover what's buried deep inside!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/fa917926cfa2b4e8072cc4dc5059e0d41bd82df6.gif"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/17552edeccd5d45ef1d8c3fbc5b1eaa30f15409a.gif"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/8ce146d4a2bb80f6f5a16f77332ff82333d71f99.gif"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/2c48d63c637fcecbd6028c793ba5a27044d41d0b.gif"]

In the upcoming season, we'll be expanding the Act 1 map, adding new branching paths for Act 1-3 and Act 1-4. These new areas feature significantly more verticality and open space, giving you ample room to maneuver during intense firefights.
But stay alert! New traps lurk in these ruins, and new enemies are waiting to test their determination against you...
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/36fe3542c3d6faceb39ece8162c9358334374e45.gif"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/56b1aa963ac7b4f34bc0de89b1d0a3107f7a4322.gif"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/16bd81319fc2cc7563b1c2516cf3452894f233ae.gif"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/dd802ca2228162a6bbabba4d233bd559de4bab46.gif"]
More powerful soldiers have been awakened, and swarms of Soul-Operated constructs are joining the battle...
We plan to add 2 new weapons and adjust the mechanism of 4 existing ones. Today, we'll start with a preview of the changes coming to two of them:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/13db74997a10fe035b79959b916d816d76dcdfaf.gif"]

We wanted to address Wild Hunt's slow reload speed in the early game while preserving its iconic double-trigger mechanism and high fire rate. With the upcoming update, if you hit or defeat an enemy with your two-shot burst, the reload time for Wild Hunt will be cut in half. At the same time, we've also optimized its spread and shooting feel.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/ece71afb9cf86208efe80c9bb9ca004539f69dbe.gif"]

items.text: Hi folks!
Hard to believe 2025 has entered its final month! As we approach the end of the year, we want to extend our sincere gratitude for your ongoing support and companionship.
We hope you've been enjoying the ever-changing battles and strategic depth that Gunfire Reborn offers.

At the same time, we're excited to announce that our final gameplay content update of the year will arrive in mid-December! This update will introduce new Dice, Fortune Cards, Vault, and Jump Stages... Stay tuned for more details!
[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//37691618/0e1ead5e9e52181c9ebccee17874dcc2b06eab0a.gif"]
Mega Summon
Tired of your summons struggling against enemy waves? The new dice effect \[Mega Summon] is here to turn the tide.
With this Dice equipped, summons like \[Iron Wing] and \[Leaf Spirit] get a big boost to their max HP, size, attack power, attack range, and more.
Team up with your newly enhanced, much larger buddies!
[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//37691618/0d5a1856467baea48f360e7c30a02bc2167448dc.gif"]
Polymorph Magic
Ready for some chaotic fun? We're adding a new Dice \[Polymorph Magic].
When you deal skill damage, there's a chance to turn your target into a harmless Dragon Qian.
[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//37691618/f8a171d7dd7eda2b152cccef33aa3b841608f39e.png"]
Extra Slot
Meet the new Fortune Card \[Extra Slot], designed to unlock your full creative potential and enable more diverse builds!
It grants an extra Dice slot with no unlock conditions, though it does come with some side effects.
We're also planning to add more Dice and Fortune Cards to keep your builds fresh, exciting, and full of surprises.
We will add new routes, Vault and Jump stage to Act 3-2 and 3-3 in this mid-season update.
[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//37691618/48829afb57ff803a815ee67121293cce84b74976.jpg"]
-New Vault: Dragon bones wind through the stage as fierce enemy waves attack. Defend the altar to claim your reward!
[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//37691618/9276e0554c9d065e881846285a141cbdc899abeb.png"]
-New Jump Stage: Navigate rushing currents and misty mountains while surrounded by solid walls. Challenge yourself to reach the top!
We're planning to adjust Yoyo's Ascensions, like "Natural Shield" and "New Dawn". Here's a preview of the changes:
Natural Shield: We want to fix the big gap in defense performance at different difficulties, especially since it doesn't do well on higher difficulties.

New Dawn: We are preserving the core experience of frequently casting Weapon Skills, but fixing an issue that allowed unlimited capacity of skill resource refunds. This will bring the Ascension's power back to its intended level.
[img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//37691618/f5919a6b1a64675a491185e439f956c9e0687527.png"]
As our weapon collection grows, we've heard your feedback: the Transcendent Arsenal needs more storage space!
So here's some good news — we're expanding its capacity to accommodate your expanding arsenal.
Due to new item limits in the Steam Points Shop, we're unable to upload the Yoyo and Cang Jue avatar and Animated stickers there.
To thank you for your love and support, we're planning to add "Echoes from Primal Grove" and previous Animated avatars and emoticon stickers directly into the game.
You'll be able to unlock them by completing specific in-game conditions with the heroes.
Beyond the mid-season update, we're also working on Season 7, new Weapons, and more. Keep an eye out for future reveals!
Thanks as always for your incredible support. See you next time!
---Gunfire Reborn Studio

releases.displayName: Tavern Chat #009：Mid-Season Update & New Stages Preview

items.text: Hi folks!
Season 5 "Arcane Talisman" has been live for over a month! How's the new Season treating you?
We're thrilled to see all the creative build ideas shared in the community — combos like Charge Talisman with Stealth or Meteor are so cool :)
Of course, if you've discovered other interesting Talisman builds, please share them in the comments! We'd love to see your ideas!
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1217060/_/"]
In the upcoming Mid-Season Update, we will introduce the following content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/123faeadf1190046a24e73bb38ae6ae57a375dae.png"]

In the update arriving in a few weeks, all Talismans upgraded to Legendary quality will acquire 3 random affixes. These affixes will expand Talisman build possibilities — such as enhancing Talisman effects, improving trigger efficiency, or additionally triggering Power Gem effects in slots…
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/6727ecdeb2ea22a0b938f07287a6be7424577f17.png"]
Unsatisfied with your affixes? You can reforge them at the Talisman Merchant to optimize your build.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/c14e4d3f224f84bf417636d45891242f723db680.png"]
When an adventure ends, you can save current Talisman affixes to the Talisman Vault for use in future runs.
We're adjusting the Ascensions for Xing Zhe's \[Heavenly Arm] faction. After the update, the damage of Xing Zhe's held weapon (excluding Soul Strike) will be improved.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/8abb609bc9597a4516cd24726b1d303e41e5d0aa.gif"]

We're optimizing Bone Dragon's delayed damage activation, while keeping its core ability to continuously pull and cluster enemies. Therefore, the adjusted Bone Dragon will retain its suction effect and trigger multiple explosions during the pulling process, dealing continuous multi-hit damage to enemies.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/31d7f90b51a7cdaff13ac4479e76c5c2058e6a57.gif"]

We've focused our adjustments on Flowing Light's weapon skill and attack range. The number of consecutive attacks from its skill now increases with charge duration—reaching up to 15 hits at full charge. This creates a brief burst phase, making it more effective than before at dealing with groups of enemies directly in front of you.
Planned for autumn, the Season 6 update will expand Act 3 with new branching stages (Act 3-2 and 3-3).
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/1bbea023b97bfa1162d23db80bc109872b8749bf.jpg"]
The new Act 3 branches will feature more distinct areas and multi-layered terrain. These stages will offer greater mobility and positioning space for agile players.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/782bf2dda5457ac872a4906dfdde06765c2d7db4.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/f6336ccc6692b66423a2e2b917c4d2e4d10e3c92.gif"]
More oceanic enemies will join the battle, while existing foes like Corrupt Monk, Catfish Man, and Catfish Grunt will change...
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37691618/a5d20db0a8c0b1a50866b5dde748854a1e76877a.gif"]
We will also add a unique new mechanism to the stages – you might leverage it to swiftly reach elevated areas or escape pursuing enemies!
We're currently deep in development on the Mid-Season Update, new stages, new Season, and DLC expansions. We'll be rolling out more development insights soon – stay tuned!
See you next time!
---Gunfire Reborn Studio

--- Gunfire Reborn Studio

Fortunes reverse under the starlight, and the Boss Trial begins! To counter the growing demonic aura, heroes harness the power of the astral realm, further activating the potential of Occult Scrolls, and elevating Spiritual Link to Star Link. Zi Xiao's fellow disciples also transform into Star Envoys, assisting players in their adventures.

As with previous seasons, "Star Link" is only available in Nightmare and Reincarnation Difficulty. Players need to select a set bundle before entering a run and assemble the corresponding Occult Scroll combination to activate the set. Unlike "Spiritual Link," these new starlight set effects are powerful and diverse, with some terrifyingly potent core sets. This season will also feature Star Envoys; find them in adventure to try out the Activation and Reception of Starlight!
Detailed gameplay rules can be previewed in the in-game Season interface.

Complete the Season tasks, increase your season level, and unlock the avatar frame "Star Link," Lei Luo's Idle Animation "Thunder Activation," Woodpecker Weapon Skin "Crystal pecker", Poisonous Ghost Weapon Skin "Snowy Plum" as well as emoticons, avatars, and other season rewards.
The difficulty of boss challenges increase, with other bosses' battle skills appearing in the stages.
Affected by starlight, you need to defeat enemies carrying Monster Scrolls to have a chance to obtain the corresponding [Interdependent Fortunes] Occult Scroll.

releases.displayName: Update Notes - 11/27: Mid-Season Update for Season 3！

items.text: Hola folks!

In this update, we have adjusted some gameplay elements of Season 3 'Demon Vanquishment' and added new demon spirit types: 'Elementalist' and 'Minikins'. Additionally, we have introduced the 'Classic Mode' option for the Season Replay System, adjusted some talent effects, and optimized the Logbook. Season 3 has 6 weeks left! Welcome everyone to experience it, have fun!

By the way, this month marks the 3rd anniversary of Gunfire Reborn v1.0 release. Over these three years, we have witnessed the millions of players' reincarnation adventures, and more and more new friends visiting the inn. Thanks for all of your companionship and encouragement, 'Gunfire Reborn' has grown step by step from the Early Access phase to where it is today. In the next year, we will continue to optimize the gaming experience and bring more interesting new content! Please stay tuned!
--- Gunfire Reborn Studio
In this update, the demon spirit family will welcome new demon spirit types: 'Elementalists' and 'Minikins'. New demon spirit types come with new affixes, so enjoy new affix builds.
Elementalist

Long time no see! It's been a while since the DLC release.

Season 3 has been live for over a month now, and we're busily beavering away to get the next phase ready. There's still a bit of a wait for Season 4, so why not take a sneak peek at what's fresh in the mid-season update for Season 3? Let's dive in!
Two new battle companions are coming!
Minikins
Demon Spirits adept at group combat, capable of multiplying the effects of affixes.
Elementalist
Demon Spirits skilled in using elements, enhancing Elemental Effects.
Talent Adjustments

A few talents will have their effects, positions, and upgrade costs adjusted. And some talent descriptions will include animated demonstrations. The cherry on top? A feature to reset all your talents, so you can reallocate your talent points.
Gallery Optimization
A new Skill Gallery will be added, which includes explanations of some basic game rules.
The Occult Scroll Gallery will be able to display the effect descriptions of the Monster Occult Scrolls from 'Bizarre Dream - Interdependent Fortunes'.
Spiritual Puppet
We have made some optimizations to the offensive methods of Spiritual Puppets, and they now have mastered the use of secondary skills!
Classic Mode
The Season Replay System will add a 'Classic Mode' option, so you can turn off the current season's gameplay, and enjoy the original flavor of adventure!
Lyn and Momo's animated stickers and avatars have hit the Points Shop! Get them while they're hot~
The mid-season update still take some time to adjust, and is expected to meet everyone in late November. Thank you for your patience and support.
We will gradually release more details, so please stay tuned.
See y'all soon :)

releases.displayName: Update Notes - 9/12: "Realm of Frost and Inkwash" release, with base game update

items.text: What's up, folks!
The New DLC 'Realm of Frost and Inkwash' is now available!
The DLC includes two new heroes: 'Lyn' and 'Momo', and four new weapons: 'Phoenix Roar', 'Starfly', 'Tracker', and 'Tempest'. Hope you enjoy it!

To celebrate the release, we are offering a 10% discount on the new DLC. The base game and other DLCs are also on sale for two weeks. Additionally, the 'Base Game + All DLC' is available as a 'Bundle' purchase option. Thank you for your support!
This update will start Season 3 'Demon Vanquishment' as well, and Season 2 'Destiny Mechanism' will end. There are also some gameplay updates:
More Fight!
New stage [Beiting Remnant]
New enemies, new challenge events
New mechanisms and traps;
More Build！
New Gemini Inscription related to weapon skills
New weapon type "Staff" and several staff inscriptions
[Ascension Fusion] can temporarily remove up to two ascensions of your own heroes...
Additionally, we have added and optimized some system functions to enhance your gaming experience.
Easy Play
New "Spirit Puppet" function in the Main Stage, allowing players to team up with bot teammates
Reconnect to the Main Stage is available,come back and fight again!
Escape from Stuck function
Reduced soul essence cost for upgrading some talents and Reincarnation levels 1-8 etc.
More content awaits you in the game！
Finally, if you encounter anything unsatisfactory in this update, please provide feedback promptly. We will continue to iterate and improve it!
Have fun and enjoy!
*Some localization texts are still in progress (German, Spanish et al... They would be temparily replaced by English). We would try to update them during this week asap. Please leave us more time.
——Gunfire Reborn Studio

If the target's HP is below the [Lethal Line], it will be executed. When the target of Frost Burial is in a or Unbalanced state, additional AoE DMG is dealt, decreasing with distance

Secondary Skill (Q): Frozen Grenades: Throws grenades with frost that explode upon contact with enemies or obstacles within 5m, dealing 500 normal DMG and causing a 2s slow effect to enemies in the area

Meanwhile, we prepare following free update content for our base game:

The "Destiny Mechanism" will no longer be the default gameplay for the current season, and the progress of the Season 2 tasks will be reset. Players can go to the season store to purchase season rewards that were not obtained in previous seasons by spending soul essence. Additionally, players can use "Season Selection" to enjoy the gameplay of previous seasons.

Terrifying monsters emitting dreadful demon aura have appeared. Heroes are summoned to subdue them. After a fierce battle, the demon aura condenses into an egg. Upon closer inspection, the egg exudes spiritual energy and divine light, hinting at a mystical creature within...

Demon Vanquishment is available only in Nightmare and Reincarnation difficulties. Players will encounter special demonized enemies during adventures. Defeat and subdue them to obtain spirit eggs or directly buy demon spirits from spirit merchants. Develop suitable demon spirits to support combat through Fusion.
Detailed rules can be seen in-game.
Season talents automatically unlock as the season levels increase. Season talents effects are extensions of season gameplay, helping players better understand and utilize seasonal gameplay.

Exclusive spiritual blessings for the season will be unlocked when season levels reach a certain level. It is also a kind of extension of season gameplay to deliver more possibilities under Reincarnation difficulty.

Starting from this season, the season levels cap will no longer be limited to level 50. Players can earn season experience by completing tasks and playing games. Once enough season experience is gained, the season level will automatically increase, and season rewards will be given for the first 50 levels, with repeated regular rewards after level 50.
The season avatar frame will display the player's current season level. Wear it and show your progress to other companions!

notes.title: A brand new stage of Act 2 [Beiting Remnant]

items.text: News from the Spirit Realm revealed that Ao Bai accidentally discovered another path to the Quicksand Pool during his adventure—an ancient ruins site situated in the desert. With new dangers and opportunities, the time for the group to embark on the adventure is about to arrive.
Entry Requirement: After finishing 'Anxi Desert' 5 times, there is a chance to enter [Beiting Remnant] when entering Act 2 Stage 2 and Stage 3.
[Toxic Spiderling]
Juvenile spider warriors can evolve into spider hunters when fully grown. If disturbed early, they will punish enemies with explosions and venom.
[Bandit Torchbearer]
Facing the insect clan, Rogue Swordsman switched to torches and took on the daily task of driving away those insects.
[Desert Fly]
It has a distant relative of the Desert Worm. The longing for the sky grants it wings. Its ability to attack enemies is somewhat reduced due to the need to stabilize itself in the air.
[Spider Hunter]
The main power of the spider clan. Even in the desert, their webs allow precise hunting and quickly approach and attack with their forelimbs.

As the vanguard warrior of the ant clan, it has comprehensive attack methods, using spears, shields, and firearms. However, due to the backward productivity, it can only use fragile shields to cover vital points.
[Bandit Electrocuter]
The exiled bandits accidentally discovered a way to store electricity. After improvement, they could use the thunder barrel on their backs to emit currents and suppress enemies.
[Desert Titan]
Its enormous stature makes it a special anomaly even among the insect clan. Beneath its slow movements lies immense power, capable of crushing any enemy in its path.
[Elite Spider Hunter]
the great talent within spider hunters. Through hundreds of combats, they evolve with tougher shells while retaining agility.
[Cannon Trap]
Affected by Demonic Aura, [Cannon Trap] appears in [Duo Fjord] with Nightmare or above difficulty
[Spider Eggs]
Giant spider eggs are scattered in [Beiting Remnant]. Destroying them may yield ammo, copper, and other supplies, but be cautious as it might also release toxic spiderlings.
The interactive zipline device can slide on the middle ropeway. Via revealing a treasure room behind the sandstorm curtain, it is filled with high walls, cliffs, rolling stones, and... more ziplines.

What's up, Folks!

"Seasons" is released in this update, and its First Season - "Arcane Ascensions" is available as well. Additionally, we adjusted and added some Inscription effects, introduced the idle animation of Crown Prince, and weapon skin assembly system. Hope everyone enjoys these contents!

Our initial plan is to rotate seasons every 3-4 months. Each new season will introduce fresh gameplay and rewards. We've also set up some minor challenges for season rewards. Players can unlock them by completing season tasks and levelling up season grades. After the season ends, old gameplay may be closed or partially retained, and progress in old season tasks will be reset (we are considering introducing a season shop in future, where players can use soul essence to unlock rewards from past seasons that they missed). Season task progress and rewards are binded only to the current game save.
If you have more ideas and suggestions regarding season rules, feel free to leave feedback. We will carefully evaluate each opinion and make timely adjustments in subsequent updates.

In the new year, there will be many ideas waiting for us to explore. Besides new heroes and weapons, new gameplay, maps and monsters are also in development. We expect to release the 2024 update roadmap in a few weeks and provide more detail. Please stay tuned.

notes.title: The First Season Is Now Open!

items.text: Each season features limited-time season gameplay and season tasks. Season gameplay may bid temporary farewell to players after the season ends. In addition, each season will have several season tasks. Completing these tasks earns soul essence rewards. Every 5 completed season tasks elevate your season level by 1, unlocking corresponding season rewards. Detailed information can be viewed by clicking on the season icon in the in-game main interface.

Thunder roars, an unknown power scattered on the mortal realm, seemingly originating from occult scrolls. After extensive exploration, it was discovered that there were three scrolls that could absorb this power. Thus, the era of [Arcane Ascensions] starts from now on...

[Arcane Ascensions] is only available in Nightmare and Reincarnation difficulties. At the beginning of the battle, players can choose one of Thunder Step, Elemental Pulses, and Thorny Carapace as the Initial Arcana. After defeating the boss and in the Vault's multiple-choice chests, players can obtain Arcane Jades to enhance the unique abilities of Initial Arcanas, assisting in battles.

Completing this season's tasks and levelling up your season grades will unlock the avatar frame [Arcane Asecensions], the Crown Prince's idle animation [Magic Scroll], the weapon skin of Illusion , as well as emotes, avatars, and other season rewards.

releases.displayName: Update Notes - November 23: "Endless Journey" begins, three new weapons debut!

items.text: Hello, everyone!

In this update, we bring you the brand-new gameplay mode —— [Endless Journey] in the [Bizarre Dream]. After defeating the final boss of the [Hyperborean Jokul], you can choose to embark on an endless adventure, exploring the limits of the levels within a limited time. At the same time, this update also introduces three new weapons: , [Dragon Breath] and [Storm Chaser]. We wish you all a great time playing!

Considering compatibility with the difficulty and pace of the battles, [Endless Journey] is currently only available from the level 9 of Reincarnation. There are still many aspects of [Endless Journey] that need improvement. If you encounter any unsatisfactory situations during your experience, we hope you can provide timely feedback, and we will continue to polish and optimize this gameplay mode in subsequent updates.
—Gunfire Studio

notes.title: Added a new option in [Bizarre Dream]

items.text: Endless Journey (Only available in Reincarnation level 9): After defeating the final boss of [Hyperborean Jokul], players can choose to embark on an endless adventure, exploring the limits of the levels within a limited time.
Enemies will become stronger, and their DMG resistance will continuously increase.
The non-cursed scroll carrying limit is 60, and recycling scrolls can provide certain bonus enhancements.
The Golden Goblet has been corrupted by demonic energy and can only replace existing ascensions with new ones. Besides, players can recycle excessive golden goblets to obtain extra bonus effect.
The Peddler, Craftsman, and Spiritual Remnant appearances will be reduced, while the Phantom Peddler and Training Master will no longer appear.
The Vault will no longer open, and defeating non-boss enemies will no longer drop coins and essences.
A new countdown system is introduced, starting at 10 minutes, and completing levels will add a certain duration.
After the countdown ends, players can still challenge the current boss, but the portal to the next act will be permanently closed.

notes.title: Adjustments to some tasks in [Mission from Above]

items.text: Each time a weapon is used to achieve a defeat/assist, the time limit for the [Weapon Forge] series tasks will be refreshed.
[Longling Tomb], [Anxi Desert], and [Hyperborean Jokul] have added some Vaults and random routes.

[Dragon Breath]: Weapon type: Launcher: Can it be dual-wielded: Yes: Weapon description: Causes an explosion when hitting enemies. The weapon enters a charging state after firing.: Weapon skill: Activating at a specific time will complete the charge early and make the next shot penetrate enemies.: Exclusive Inscription: Each activation of the weapon increases the stack by 1 (up to 3 stacks, the stack is cleared if activation fails). At full stacks, the weapon's explosion count +1.: Unlock method: Defeat [Flame Bomber] 20 times.
Weapon type: Rifle
Can it be dual-wielded: Yes
Weapon skill: Hitting enemies multiple times while aiming puts them in a vulnerable state: all weapon damage will trigger a critical hit.
Exclusive Inscription 1: The more times the enemy's weak spot is hit, the stronger the effect of its vulnerable state.

releases.displayName: Update Notes June 1: "Artisan and Magician" release, with updates of base game.

items.text: What’s up Folks, the second DLC “Artisan and Magician” now has officially been released!

It contains two new heroes: [Zi Xiao] and . [Zi Xiao] is a hero mainly focused on “strategy” and “Fortunate”. By utilizing his unique mechanism of occult scrolls reset and quality upgrade, players can optimize the triggering probability of powerful skill effects. has an auto-battle partner named “Iron Wing”. When you were knocked down, don’t be nervous and Iron Wing with “Emergency Function” talent will come to save you at once.
There are also 4 brand-new weapons at the same time! , [Jet Octopus], [Wolf Gaze] and [Star Ring]. Hope you will like them!

In this update, we have also brought some free content for all players. The [Bizarre Dream] now offers two additional Modes: [Transcendent Arsenal] and [Ascension Fusion]. In the [Transcendent Arsenal], you can collect your favorite weapons, while in [Ascension Fusion], you can use Ascensions from different heroes to create unique BD. Meanwhile, we have iterated on the gameplay of [Qing Yan] and introduced a batch of new occult scrolls and inscriptions. To those occult scrolls and inscriptions that have existed, we also have made adjustments to them.

Finally, we get some exciting news to share with everyone: “Gunfire Reborn" has surpassed 3 million copies in global sales for the PC version! We would like to express our gratitude to all the players for their support and love. We will continue to update and refine the game, striving to bring you more joy. As a special commemoration of reaching 3 million copies sold, we have prepared an exclusive commemorative level frame. All players who own the game before the end of this promotional event (before 12:00 AM on June 16th, 2023) will automatically receive this exclusive frame.

If you encounter any areas in this update that you are not satisfied with, we encourage you to provide feedback to us promptly. We will work together with you to continuously iterate and improve on these updates. Wish you all a joyful gaming experience!
Gunfire Studio
After purchasing DLC “Artisan and Magician”, you will automatically unlock following content:

Meanwhile, we also prepare following free update notes for base game.
Two new-added options in [Bizarre Dream]：

（1）[Transcendent Arsenal]：Players will encounter an arsenal guard after clearing the vault in scene 3 and 4 or defeating the Pole Monarch. At this time, players can entrust the weapons they've collected during adventure to the arsenal guard for safekeeping. In a new game, players can retrieve these weapons when they meet the arsenal guard again. Meanwhile, the vault will become more dangerous, with previously unseen Demonic Aura Diffusion occurring. To facilitate weapon collection, players' weapon inventory will be expanded with three additional slots for backup weapons. To collect a desired weapon, simply hold down the pickup button to place it in a backup slot. Additionally, players can view other players' collected weapons in the team interface.

（2）[Ascension Fusion]: When players reach the boss stage in Longling Tomb, they can select Ascension from other heroes. The chosen Ascension will not be obtained immediately; instead, there is a higher chance of encountering it during subsequent interactions with the Golden Goblet. There are currently 24 Ascensions available for selection, with 6 options presented each time, and up to 2 of them can be chosen.

The latest DLC "Artisan and Magician" and a free update for the base game will be released on June 1, 2023, at 12:00 AM (UTC +8)! Thank you for your patience, and we'll see you next week!
Price Adjustment for DLC "Visitor of Spiritual Realm"

Due to ongoing changes in the international currency market, the pricing of our game has been significantly affected in various regions. To prevent disruptive effects from exchange rate fluctuations on regional pricing, we will be making individual price adjustments for the DLC "Visitor of Spiritual Realm" in a very few specific regions to some extent on May 26th at 0:00 PDT (GMT-7). Players who have already purchased the game will not be affected by this price adjustment.

The new DLC "Artisan and Magician" for "Gunfire Reborn" will be officially launched on June 1st, and the base game will also have seasonal promotions and discounts in the coming weeks. Please continue to stay tuned for our updates and announcements, and we appreciate your understanding and support!
--Gunfire Studio

items.text: What’s up, folks!

Finally, here comes the Autumn Update of Gunfire Reborn. In this update, there is a new game mode – Spiritual Assault. In Spiritual Assault, you will have a more intense combat experience and massive monsters assault. You have to survive to the very end and defeat the final boss – Gluttony. Meanwhile, there are 2 new weapons [Wheel Saw] and [Radioactive Gauntlet]. Hope you guys will like it!

Spiritual Assault is our new experiment for rapid combat style There are more details that could be improved. If you have any problems and suggestions during the game, please let us know. We will keep polishing the game in the future.
P.S. Gluttony only appears as the final boss in Spiritual Assault. Perhaps Gluttony will be one of the random boss of the main stage in the future.
Have fun in Gunfire Reborn!
---Gunfire Reborn Studio

If you have any problems during the game and cannot use the in-game feedback function, you could send your Steam ID, issues descriptions and screenshots to qhstaff@2980.com, we will locate and fix the problem as soon as possible.

Spiritual Assault is a whole new game mode. It will be unlocked when you reach Level 60. You can enter it from main menu. Currently there is a new map – Mid Fjord – in this mode, and there will be more new maps in the future.

In this mode, general Talents are not available except the Exclusive Talents of each Hero. Instead, you have to use Spirit Concentrator and Spiritual Jade.: *There are 7 different shapes of [Spiritual Jade]. Each [Spiritual Jade] offers a unique bonus for you.: * [Spirit Concentrator] is where you place [Spiritual Jades], and make them in effect during the game. You could expand the capacity of [Spirit Concentrator] with Soul Essences.: * Instead of putting all [Spiritual Jades] in [Spirit Concentrator] at once, you have to manage the limited space based on your builds.: *Some [Spiritual Jades] need to be unlocked.

In Spiritual Assault, players have to survive and fight against constant assault of numerous enemies. By defeating enemies, there will be EXP drops. Obtain it and level yourself up. Every time you level up, you could choose a reward. In team-play, EXP progression is synchronized.

For every 10 minutes, there will be a Massive Elite Monster challenge. You could obtain the [Spiritual Goblet] once you finish the challenge. It will offer a powerful Spiritual Ascension to you.: *Spiritual Ascension is divided into General and Exclusive one. Ascensions taken in each category increase the odds of getting a Spiritual Ascension related to that specific category. The options can be refreshed by costing Soul Essence.
Once you survived for 30 minutes, the Portal that leads to Chaos Realm will open. You have to defeat the terrific boss – Gluttony.
Players will get Soul Essence based on their survive time as the reward.

Weapons, Occult Scrolls, and Achievements cannot be unlocked in Spiritual Assault. Some Occult Scrolls, Ascensions, and Talents will be changed as well in Spiritual Assault. You could check it out at the preparation phase.

notes.title: New Boss for Spiritual Assault – Gluttony

items.text: Over the Northern skyline, a purple aura spread all over the sky. It was supposed to be an auspicious sign, but as the sky became dark, the earth became darker, and the Evil Spirit tormented the continent, people start to realize that it was the source of the ominous disasters. A traveler trespassed into its Realm, and witnessed how IT devour the whole world and overshadow the Sun. Therefore it was named Gluttony. it is said that Gluttony is so destructive that it can reshape the continent, and corrode people’s mind.

items.text: Hello everyone! Our first DLC – Visitors of Spirit Realm is finally here!
There are 2 new heroes – and [Xing Zhe] and 4 new weapons – [Cloud Weaver], [Arc Light], [Lighting Ksana], . Hope you guys will like it!.

We also bring you other new stuffs – a new game mode [Bizarre Dream]. You could build various Set in Spiritual Link, and face a more severe challenge in Mysterious Jokul. A little heads-up, since the new mode can be quite challenging, it will only be available in Reincarnation. We will keep optimizing and updating this mode. Feel free to share your opinion about it.

Last but not least, we made some adjustments to Ascensions, Spirit Blessings, Occult Scrolls, Weapon Inscriptions and the boss “Golem”, and added some new Enhanced Occult Scrolls as well. If you have any problems during the game, please report to us, and we will make our game better with all your supports! Enjoy your game in Gunfire Reborn!
--Gunfire Studio

notes.title: Gunfire Reborn DLC – Visitors of Spirit Realm

items.text: The following contents will be unlocked after purchasing the Visitors of Spirit Realm:
Capable of Shapeshift, persisted in hunting demons.

Xing Zhe’s origin remains unknown. He is capable of summoning clone that cudgels his enemy in various ways. Xing Zhe also uses the Essence Chain to extract enemies’ power and turns it into his own strength.

Primary Skill (E): Soul Strike: Pull out a hair and blow it to the enemy. When it lands on the enemy, summon a clone that performs hits up to 4 times to enemies within 10m. Every hit deals Weapon DMG based on the held weapon. Soul Strike has additional effects based on the Weapon Type. Each enemy can be struck by once in a single Soul Strike.

Secondary Skill (Q): Essence Chain: Draw out Soul Essence from your bracelet, dealing 400 DMG to up to 4 enemies, reducing their Movement Speed by 90% for 1s, and extracting their souls to enhance your own weapon. +2 temporary Weapon Levels for 6s.
Heaven Armory: For every 50 enemies killed, a Special Ammo weapon will drop.
Indestructible Spell: +15 Max HP and Max Shield. For every 10% Shield lost, +10% Shield Recovery Speed.
Enhanced Artifact: +200 Essence Chain Base DMG.
Proficient Trick: +50% Soul Strike DMG.
Steady Stance: Upon taking lethal DMG from an enemy, HP is fixed at 1, become immune to DMG for 1s, and perform a hit, dealing 200% DMG to that enemy. If the enemy is killed by , recover 100% Shield.
[Dimensional Strike]: +1 Soul Strike uses. +40% Weapon DMG for every hit performed, up to 10 stacks. Reset when taking DMG from an enemy.
[Essence Drainer]: +1 extra temporary Weapon Level for every enemy affected by it. For every Weapon Level of the current weapon, +40% Essence Chain DMG.
[Weapon Mastery]: +200% total bonus from Assaulter, Generalist and Breacher talents. Both weapons equipped share their bonuses.
Master the spirit, and blaze the sky with crimson flame.

As the descendant of the Qingqiu Gens, Li is capable of consuming her enemies with scorching flame, and summoning the fiery spirit to finish things off. Li also figured to combine her flame techniques with powerful firearms, which allows her to take down enemies efficiently, yet elegantly.

Primary Skill (E): Spiritual Flame: Cast a shockwave which deals 350 Fire DMG to enemies along the way. Every 1 energy consumed (Up to 60) during the charge will boost the DMG by 2%. The ability will when consuming 30 energy, increasing the DMG and AoE range by 50%. Initial maximum energy is 60. Restore 2% energy per second automatically, or 2 energy when killing enemies with Fire DMG.
Secondary Skill (Q): Blazing Meteor: Summon a Blazing Meteor, dealing 500 Fire DMG. Recover 2 energy for every enemy hit by Blazing Meteor.
Practice Makes Perfect: When Spiritual Flame hits an enemy, energy consumed will be accumulated. For every 1200 energy accumulated, +30% charging speed of Spiritual Flame, up to 3 stacks.
Flame Arsenal: Drop an extra Fire DMG weapon after defeating a Boss or an Elite.
Overheating: +100 Blazing Meteor Base DMG.
Flaming Cape: +20 Max Shield. Upon taking DMG, inflict Burning Effect to the enemy.
Hunt of Fire: +50% DMG against enemies in Burning Effect.
[Flame Dance]: +30% Weapon DMG and +5% enemy DMG taken when inflicting the Burning Effect on the enemy. (up to 10 stacks)

: +1% DMG of Blazing Meteor for every 1 energy stored. When casting Blazing Meteor at a target, cast Blazing Meteor on all enemies within 8m (CD 3s). (Every remaining Blazing Meteor use will reduce the cooldown by 0.1s, up to 2s)
[Raging Inferno]: +15% base DMG of Spiritual Flame for every enemy hit by it (-10 stacks when missed, up to 30 stacks). Recover 1 energy for every 2m moved.
[Cloud Weaver]
Type: Pistol
Dual-Wield: Support
Intro: Launches 5 controllable spiritual spikes. DMG of the next attack increases with flight distance.
The upcoming attack to an enemy hit by Cloud Weaver causes an extra attack that deals 30% DMG.
Increases the DMG to the same target by 20% for every attack (Up to 100%).
[Arc Light]
Type: Pistol
Dual-Wield: Support
Intro: Inflict lightning that automatically attacks nearby enemies. Every 4 hits with lightning grants 1 use of Dagger Fan.
Weapon Skill: Cast a fan of daggers, marking hit enemies. Inflict 2 extra lightings when a dagger or lightning hits the marked enemy.
Inflict 1 extra lightning when hitting the enemy.
Type: Rifle
Dual-Wield: Support
Intro: After 18 shots, you can deploy a shield.
Weapon Skill: Deploys a shield that blocks attacks. Recast to retract the shield early. When the shield is retracted, it fires a powerful seeking shot. DMG is based on the number of blocked attacks.
Shield retraction fires 3 powerful shots, but they no longer seek enemies.
[Lighting Ksana]
Type: Sniper
Dual-Wield: Support
Intro: Shooting a teammate deploys a DMG blocking shield. DMG being blocked or causing no-scope Crit Hits gains charges. Scoped shots consume charges for Enhanced Shots with higher CritX.
Deploy a shield on yourself after 3 Crit Hits with Enhanced Shots.

New Game Mode (Available in Reincarnation): In this update, a new game mode is added into the game – Bizarre Dream. In Bizarre Dream, you can have various game experiences by enabling different game options. There are 2 options for now:
Spiritual Link: Affected by the Spiritual Aura, Occult Scrolls, Weapons and Ascensions will offer additional buffs in a specific combination.

Mysterious Jokul: In this mode, the Hyperborean Jokul is more dangerous. To confront the rigorous challenge ahead, all Peddlers and Phantom Peddlers are well-stocked, and you can refresh once for free. Spiritual Remnant in Jokul is awake as well. You can exchange the Spirit Blessing once.
Balanced some Challenge Event

[Mark Chaser]: Old: Each time [Fatal Bloom] marks an unmarked enemy, increase weapon DMG and skill DMG by 8%/12%/16% for 8/8/10s; (Lv3) +5% Lucky Shot Chance for every stack.: New: Each time [Fatal Bloom] marks an unmarked enemy, increase weapon DMG and skill DMG by 10%/20%/30% for 8/8/10s (up to 40%/80%/150%).

[Flower Chain]: Old: When hitting an enemy that's marked by [Fatal Bloom] with a weapon, deal 100% weapon DMG to up to 2/4/5 other marked enemies. (Lv3) If the initial hit is a Crit Hit, then so are the following hits, but their CritX will not exceed 3.0x: New: Hitting the enemy marked with Fatal Blossom will deal 100% Weapon DMG to up to 2/3/4 enemies within 15m, and mark them with Fatal Blossom. There is a 0%/30%/100% chance to deal DMG twice.: [Qian Sui]

[Solid Shell]: Old: -5%/10%/15% DMG taken for every enemy within 10 meters. (Lv3) Reset the cooldown of Tidal Aspis when the Shield is broken.: New: [-5%/10%/15%]/[-10%/20%/30%]/[-15%/30%/45%] DMG taken for every normal enemy/elite/boss within 10 meters. Reset Tidal Aspis's cooldown when shield is broken.
Weapon Adjustments: Added the Full-Auto mode: Added the Full-Auto mode

Inscription Adjustments: Old: (Gemini) Plant a spore on the target when hitting enemy and deal extra damage when the spore from different weapons meet together. (Stacks will not be reset after encounter).: New: (Gemini) Plant spores on hit. The amount of spores is equivalent to on-hit Projectiles and Projectiles of the other weapon. When the amount reaches 30, deals additional Weapon DMG to the target.
Spirit Blessings Adjustments

Painkiller: Old: Obtain a random elemental effect upon taking DMG, and convert all negative elemental effects applied to the hero to bonus with opposite effects.: New: Obtain a random elemental effect upon dealing DMG, and convert all negative Elemental Effects applied to the hero to bonus with opposite effects.

Fake Death: Old: Instead of falling immediately upon taking lethal DMG, you can enter a state of "Fake Death" for 10s, and you won't fall during this state. Killing any enemy will end the state early. (Cooldown 120s): New: Upon taking lethal DMG, you will not be downed immediately, but enter the "Fake Death". Killing an enemy will end the "Fake Death" and be invincible for 3s (CD 45s).

Copycat: Old: Upon killing (or having a kill assist on) an enhanced monster, you obtain their enhanced effects, which lasts for some time. Different enhanced effects will be applied at the same time while the same effect will have the duration refreshed.: New: Upon killing or assisting in killing an enhanced monster, you obtain their enhanced effects, which lasts for some time. Different enhanced effects will be applied at the same time while the same effect will be stacked (up to 3 stacks) and refreshed.

Supreme Craftsman: Old: You can all inscriptions of a weapon at the craftsman. Craftsman can each weapon up to 3 times.: New: You can all inscriptions of a weapon at the craftsman. Craftsman can each weapon up to 3 times. costs no copper.

A Good Man: Old: Reviving a teammate or being revived grants you +2%/s HP recovery, +5% Movement speed and +30% Weapon and Skill DMG for 180s. (Up to 10 stacks): New: Reviving or being revived grants you +2%/s HP recovery, +5% Movement Speed and +30% Weapon and Skill DMG (Up to 10 stacks). Reset at every starting stage.

Overconsumption: Old: +150% Weapon and Skill DMG, -30% Cooldown, +30% Movement Speed, +30 Max HP and Max Shield/Armor. For every Occult Scroll you carry, -3.3% total bonus mentioned above.: New: +300% Weapon and Skill DMG, -50% Cooldown, +50% Movement Speed, +50 Max HP and Max Shield/Armor. For every Legend/Rare/Normal Occult Scroll you have, -3%/2%/1% total bonus mentioned above.
Endless Assault: Old: Gain a secondary skill use every 3s: New: Gain a secondary skill use every 3s. +100% Secondary Skill uses.
Ultimate Firearm: There's a 40% -> 75% chance to drop an weapon

Steady Profit: Old: You can purchase 2 Enhanced Occult Scrolls from Phantom Peddler.: New: You can purchase 2 Enhanced Occult Scrolls from Phantom Peddler. Merch in Phantom Peddler can be refreshed once.
Skill Freak: Old: The secondary skill deals double DMG: New: There is a 75%/25% chance for a Secondary Skill to deal 200%/300% DMG.
Battle Scarred: Old: -1% DMG taken for every 2% HP you have. Also, if HP is less than 75%, recover 5% HP per second.: New: +5%/s HP. -1% DMG taken for every 2% HP you have.
Thorny Bloom: Upon picking up Fatal Blossom while the uses are full, gain stacks for [Thorny Bloom].
Blossom Enthusiast: Old: -8 hits required to trigger [Fatal Bloom] additional DMG: New: Hit unmarked enemy will mark them with Fatal Blossom. -8 hits required to trigger [Fatal Bloom] additional DMG.

High-powered Arc: Old: +150% Chain Lightning Base DMG for each increase to the maximum bounces of Chain Lightning.: New: +3 bounces for Chain Lighting, +100% bouncing rang. +150% Chain Lightning Base DMG for each increase to the maximum bounces of Chain Lightning.
Double Tap: Upon hitting an enemy with a weapon, deal DMG based on the weapon’s Base DMG and Projectile count, including all bonuses applied to the triggering hit. (CD: 1 -> 0.5s)

Elemental Orb: Old: Dealing Weapon DMG will create an Elemental Orb (CD: 3s). The type of Elemental Orb changes when reloading. +5% Elemental DMG for 10s (up to 25 stacks) and -0.1s CD for Elemental Orb when defeating an enemy affected by an Elemental Effect.: New: Dealing Weapon DMG will create an Elemental Orb (CD: 3s). The type of elemental orb changes when reloading. -0.1s CD for Elemental Orb and +5% Elemental DMG for 10s when defeating a normal enemy affected by an Elemental Effect, or inflicting an Elemental Effect on an Elite/Boss monster. (up to 25 stacks).

Atomic Bomb: Old: When using a secondary skill, there is a 30% chance to toss all remaining grenades without consuming uses. +50% Explosive Grenade DMG for 1s (stackable) every time any grenade deals DMG.: New: When using a secondary skill, there is a 40% chance to toss all remaining grenades without consuming uses. +50% Explosive Grenade DMG for 1s, every time any grenade deals DMG (up to 1000%).

Field Proficiency: Old: Gain +5% Lucky Shot Chance and -5% Dash/Primary Skill cooldown every time you kill, or assisted in killing an elite monster/boss (including the ones you killed before acquiring this spiritual blessing).: New: +10% Lucky Shot Chance and -6% Dash/Primary Skill cooldown, for every elite/boss killed or assisted on kill in the entire run.
Talent Adjustments
Generalist: Increase projectile speed by 20/40/60/80/100% when using pistols; Increase the number of projectiles by 0.5/1/1.5/2/2.5 -> 5%/10%/15%/20%/25% when using shotguns.
New Enhanced Occult Scrolls
[Enhanced Refresh Addict]: Cost less coppers to refresh Peddler's merch. (Including sold out merch)
[Enhanced Ancient Timer]: -50% Primary Skill cooldown.
[Enhanced Break the Ice]: Lose 1 level on a random Ascension, but gain 5 Occult Scrolls. (At least 3 Legendary Scroll)
[Enhanced 3rd Time Unlucky]: +50% Weapon DMG. Obtain 1 Occult Scroll for every 3 Peculiar Chests you opened. (Cannot be discarded)
[Enhanced Glazed Sight]: +0.5x CritX. For every 10% HP you have, +0.1x CritX.

[Enhanced Rational Consumption]: +80% Skill DMG. Every time you interact with the Peddler, gain 10% Skill DMG. Every time you purchase from the Peddler, lose 5% Skill DMG. (Will not drop below 0%. Scroll cannot be discarded)
[Enhanced Extravagant Consumption]: +1% All DMG for every 100 copper spent in the entire run. If you bring over 500 copper to the next stage, the excess part will be spent automatically.

[Refresh Addict]: The cost of refresh is now decreased by 50%
[Double Exhilaration]: Old: Secondary Skill Capacity gets doubled.: New: +100% Secondary Skill Capacity.

[Enhanced Double Exhilaration]: Old: Secondary Skill Capacity gets doubled, and there's a 50% chance to not consume any use upon using secondary skill.: New: +100% Secondary Skill Capacity, and there's a 50% chance to not consume any use upon using secondary skill.

In single play, If the boss is defeated soon after the player is downed, it will be regarded as victory and the player will be revived automatically.

- Acquire 15 different effects of Spiritual Link.

[Thunder Nemesis]: Original: When casting [Fatal Current], summon thunderbolts to strike on random enemies around.: New: When casting [Fatal Current] or [Fatal Current] ends, summon thunderbolts to strike on random enemies around.: 3. [Heart of Battle]: Original: Reduce cooldown of [Fatal Current] upon every critical kill.: New: Reduce cooldown of [Fatal Current] upon killing enemies in Shock Effect.: 4. [Lightning Governor] Level 3 Effect: Original: During [Fatal Current], if [Chain Lightning] kills an enemy, add 1s to the active [Fatal Current] duration.: New: During [Fatal Current], add 1s to the current duration upon every enemy killed.: 5. [Bolt from the blue]: +3s [Fatal Current] duration
[Crown Prince]: 1. Tweaked the interval when throwing multiple Smoke Grenades. Crown Prince may now throw grenades faster.
Shield: 50→65
Shield recovery delay: 3.5s→3s
Optimized mechanism of splitting. The split projectiles are more controllable now, providing a chance to deal huge DMG if all projectiles hit the target.
Times of splits: 3 → 2
Number of split projectiles: 1-2-4-8 → 1-3-9
Split distance: 0.5-2-4 → 1-3
DMG Dealt for each projectile, per split: 250%-200%-150%-100% → 400%-120%-90%
Projectile Speed: 30 → 50
Piercing: 1 → 99
Removed the horizontal recoil, and tweaked vertical recoil
It will now knock back enemies continuously, but only those within 7 meters will be affected. If enemies hit any barrier on their way back, they will receive additional DMG.
Tweaked the re-centering speed of the muzzle after firing the weapon.
[Thunder Storm]
No longer pierces enemies.
Inscription

’s Exclusive Inscription: Projectiles will horizontally split for 3 times → Projectiles will horizontally split for 5 times.: +20% DMG for every time the projectile splits → +30% DMG for every time the projectile splits.
’s Exclusive Inscription: +500% Effective Range; +1 piercing. → +200% Effective Range; +1 piercing.
Other Inscriptions: +1.2x CritX, -25%RoF. → +1.2x CritX, -10% RoF.: +40% Lucky Shot Chance, -25% RoF. → +40% Lucky Shot Chance, -10% RoF.
Optimized the game performance when players use [Thunderclap Gloves] to trigger Miasma frequently.
Optimized the crosshair of [Wild Hunt]
[Pole Monarch]:
Improved the pathfinding of the BOSS when he dashes to prevent him from reaching some undesired places.
Slightly increased base HP.
Increased Attack Power by 10%.
Increased HP of spiritual aura containers in both co-op mode as well as reincarnation difficulty.
[Elite Thunderous Stalker]
Ammo Supply will be dropped when mirror images have 0 HP remaining.
After re-summoning mirror images, the real Stalker will have any debuff currently applied to itself removed.
The mirror images are now immune to Manipulation Effect.
Reduced the probability of re-summoning mirror images when the real Stalker is under attack.
Not only the real [Elite Thunderous Stalker] but also mirror images will now attack the same player.
[Elite Mandrill Cavalry]:
Added visual effects representing that the rider is invincible when the mount is alive.
Added visual effects representing the countdown for the rider to re-summon a new mount after the old one is defeated.
The cooldown for their charge attack is reduced if it gets interrupted.
Some of the monster’s skills will now inflict the Burning Effect.
Reduced the rider’s additional DMG taken when the mount is alive.
[Mountain Guard]:
Increased recovery speed after a sword attack.
Increased probability of hunting down players via slam attacks.
[Mandrill Cavalry]:
Adjusted the special effect of sweeping attack, and reduced the chance of displaying abnormal special effects.
Added 2 new routes in [Hyperborean Jokul - Stage 1].
Affected by demonic aura, tornado traps will now appear in [Anxi Desert] on Elite difficulty and above.
The challenge event [Elite Coyote appears!] will appear on Normal difficulty now.
Tweaked combat flow in [Snowy Fairyland].
Tweaked combat flow in [Longling Tomb - Stage 3].
Increased the seal’s HP in Reincarnation difficulty.
Optimized the location of a Seal-guarding Vault entrance that was originally difficult to interact for players in [Anxi Desert - Stage 3].
Weapons obtained via peculiar chests will now come with full ammo.
Optimized some in-game text related to [Peculiar Chests].
Optimized the performance of rolling boulders in [Desert Ruins].
Tweaked the location of a Treasure Chest in [Shoreside Valley].
Enhanced Scrolls:
[Enhanced·Brutal Gloves]: Original: +35% weapon and skill DMG.: New: +50% weapon and skill DMG.

[Enhanced·Bloody Ammo]: Original: Automatic weapons can continue to fire with an empty magazine if the Fire button is held, but each extra shot deals 1 normal DMG to yourself. (This scroll won't knock you down.): New: You can continue to fire automatic weapons even with an empty magazine as long as the Fire button is held, gaining +10% Weapon DMG per shot for 5s (up to +100%), but each extra shot deals DMG that equals to 1% of your current total HP to yourself.
[Enhanced·Perfect Sixth]: Original: Every sixth shot gains +50% DMG.: New: Every sixth shot gains +100% DMG.

[Enhanced·Improved Clip]: Original: Whenever an ammo pack is being picked up, the ammo is doubled and it directly goes into the magazine instead of your backpack. Increases your Movement Speed by 25% until reloading.: New: Whenever an ammo pack is picked up, it directly refills the magazine instead of reserve ammo, and increases your Movement Speed by 25% and Weapon DMG by 50% until next reload.

[Enhanced·Giant slayer]: Original: When hitting an enemy, there is a 10% chance to deal 15% of the enemy's max HP as True DMG. (Up to 5,000 DMG per hit): New: When hitting an enemy, there is a 10% chance to deal an additional 15% of the enemy's max HP as True DMG. (5000 * the number of players in your squad at most per hit)

[Enhanced·Ninja Invincibility]: Original: +10% Lucky Shot Chance per second (up to +100%). Resets after triggering a Lucky Shot.: New: +5% Lucky Shot Chance per second (up to 10 stacks). Upon reaching the max stacks, resets after triggering a Lucky Shot.

[Enhanced·Rock-Hard Determination]: Original: +50% DMG while being stationary; the bonus will remain for 4s after moving: New: +80% DMG while being stationary; the bonus will remain for 4s after moving.

[Enhanced·Lightless Shield]: Original: Gain 3 stacks of Lightless Shield every 30s. Each stack prevents an attack and is consumed afterwards, granting +75% weapon and skill DMG for 3s. You can only have up to 3 stacks at any given time.: New: Gain 4 stacks of Lightless Shield every 30s. Each stack negates incoming DMG and is consumed afterwards. You can only have up to 4 stacks at any given time.

[Enhanced·Phantom Skin]: Original: Gain 1 stack of Phantom Skin every 10s. 1 stack is consumed whenever you take DMG, restoring 50% Shield/Armor and granting +30% movement speed for 3s. You can only have up to 3 stacks at any given time.: New: Gain 1 stack of Phantom Skin every 10s. A stack is consumed whenever you take DMG, restoring 100% of your Shield/Armor. You can only have up to 3 stacks of Phantom Skin at any given time.

[Enhanced·Magnetic Coil]: Original: Every 6s release an electromagnetic pulse that inflicts the Shock Effect for 6s on all enemies it passes through.: New: Every 6s and every time you deal a crit hit (CD: 1s), you launch an electromagnetic pulse that inflicts Shock effect on all enemies affected by it.

[Enhanced·Blazing Hoop]: Original: Every 6s release a flame pulse that deals 200 Fire DMG and inflicts the Burning Effect for 3s on all enemies it passes through.: New: Every 6s and every time you deal a crit hit (CD: 1s), you launch a flame pulse that inflicts a Burning effect, which lasts for 3s, and deal 200 Fire DMG on all enemies affected by it.

[Enhanced·Realm of Corrosion]: Original: Every 6s release a corrosive pulse that inflicts the Decay Effect for 5s on all enemies it passes through.: New: Every 6s and every time you deal a crit hit (CD : 1s), you launch a corrosive pulse that inflicts Decay effect on all enemies affected by it.

[Enhanced·Airbag]: Original: Recover 100% HP instantly when Shield/Armor fully depletes.: New: Lose 2% of HP per second if your current Shield/Armor is more than 0, but recover 100% HP instantly when Shield/Armor fully depletes.
Adjusted the prices of some enhanced Occult Scrolls.
Spiritual Blessing Changes:

【Splinter Orb】: Original: When casting Energy Orb, two additional energy orbs are launched to the left and right of the main energy orb at the same time.: New: When casting Energy Orb, an additional energy orb will be launched respectively to the left and right of the main one at the same time. -1s Energy Orb cooldown for every enemy hit by an energy orb.

【Weapon Genius】: Original: When dual-wielding, +30% RoF and 30% chance to not consume ammo when both weapons are the same type, otherwise +50% Lucky Shot Chance.: New: -50% Dual-Wield cooldown. +75% Lucky Shot Chance while dual-wielding, and off-hand weapon shares the same level as the main-hand weapon.

【Battle Scarred】: Original: When HP is less than 100%, there's a 75% chance to recover 20% max HP every time you take DMG: New: -1% DMG taken for every 2% HP you have. Also, if HP is less than 75%, recover 5% HP per second.

【Unstoppable Momentum】: Original: +100% base DMG for the next leap when you hit an enemy with a leap (up to 10 stacks). Removes all stacks on a miss.: New: For each enemy hit by a Leap, +100% next Leap base DMG and gain a 5% chance to reset the cooldown (up to 10 stacks). Removes all stacks on a miss.

【Bladed Cleave】: Original: Cleave instantly kills normal/elite monsters with 25% HP or less, and bosses with 15% HP or less.: New: Cleave instantly kills normal/elite monsters with 25% HP or less, and bosses with 15% HP or less. +30% Cleave DMG for every remaining charge of Cleave.

【Lightning Messenger】: Original: After dealing a crit hit, apply shock effect to the inflicted enemy and all foes within 10m; When Lei Luo attacks the enemy in shock effect, increases weapon DMG and skill DMG by 100%: New: After dealing a crit hit, inflict Shock effect on the inflicted enemy and all enemies within 3m; When Lei Luo attacks an enemy affected by Shock effect, increases Weapon and Skill DMG by 100%.

【High-powered Arc】: Original: When casting [Chain Lightning], +100% [Chain Lightning] skill DMG per bounce: New: +150% base [Chain Lightning] DMG for each increase to the maximum bounces of [Chain Lightning]. (+300% by default)
【Thunder & Glory】: Original: -50% [Fatal Current] Cooldown: New: -50% [Fatal Current] Cooldown. For each enemy hit by a thunderbolt, +40% base DMG to the next thunderbolt for 10s. (Up to 30 stacks)

【Sword Mastery】: Original: You can stack Blade Heart even when [Swords Out] is on cooldown: New: +50% RoF while using [Swords Out], and you can stack Blade Heart even when [Swords Out] is on cooldown.

【Ice Blade】: Original: Deals an additional 10% of the enemy's current HP as True DMG (up to 5,000 True DMG to elite monsters/bosses) upon hitting an enemy with a flying sword.: New: Flying Swords deal an additional 10% of an enemy's current HP as True DMG. (For elites/bosses, up to (5000 * the number of players in your squad) True DMG at most per hit).

【Backfire】: Original: Reflect significant DMG back to all enemies within 10m upon taking DMG.: New: Reflects significant AoE DMG back to all enemies within 10m upon taking DMG or hitting an enemy with .: Note: You can trigger this blessing by using in the new version.

【A Good Man】: Original: Reviving a teammate or being revived grants you +2%/s HP recovery, +20% Movement Speed, and +30% weapon and skill DMG for 60s. (Stackable, up to 3 times): New: Reviving a teammate or being revived grants you +2%/s HP recovery, +5% Movement Speed, and +30% Weapon and Skill DMG for 180s. (Up to 10 stacks)

【Copycat】: Original: After killing an enhanced monster, you obtain their enhanced effect, which lasts for some time. Different enhanced effects will be applied at the same time while the same effect will have its duration refreshed.: New: Upon killing (or having a kill assist on) an enhanced monster, you obtain their enhanced effects, which lasts for some time. Different enhanced effects will be applied at the same time while the same effect will have the duration refreshed.: Note: In this patch, we have adjusted the mechanism of this blessing so that you may obtain an enhanced effect via a kill assist. Also, we have increased the duration of each enhanced effect.

Added unlockable profile frames for each hero. Each frame for each hero comes with a unique challenge for you to complete. (See detail in frame selection)

releases.displayName: Update Notes - 12/03/2021: [Pole Monarch] gameplay changes and BUG fixes

items.text: Hello everyone!

In this update, we have adjusted the gameplay mechanics of Pole Monarch's countdown phase and fixed some bugs in v1.0. We wish that we could still hear more feedback from our community as usual when you experience new ways to take it down. In the meanwhile, we are still improving game content including the Pole Monarch, some of which are supposed to be introduced by the end of this month, so stay tuned.
--Gunfire Studio

If you encounter issues such as game crashes, failure to start, etc., and you cannot use the feedback function, please send your Steam name with the detailed descriptions of the issue or screenshots to our email (qhstaff@2980.com). We will check and fix the issue as soon as possible.

Adjustments of [Pole Monarch]'s countdown phase: 1. Players may still win the fight if they can deplete all the Shield of the boss within the time limit.: 2. Instead of losing the battle, failure of defeating the Pole Monarch during the countdown phase will lead players to the ultimate rage phase. Players can also win the battle if they successfully defeat Pole Monarch in this phase.: 3. Pole Monarch will now start the countdown when it only has 5% HP remaining.: 4. Decreased the countdown from 15s to 10s.
Optimized visual warnings for some of [Pole Monarch]'s skills.
Optimized [Mountain Guard]'s sprinting animation.
Added ammo drops to different phases of [Abyssal Serpent].
Added the reloading animation for [Mandrill Cavalry].
Slightly increased the movement speed of [Mutant Penguin]. They will get moderately closer to players in combat.
Optimized the model and animation of [Ao Bai] in lobby.
Removed the red dot that appeared on [Double Caliber] in the weapon panel.
Lowered the difficulty of combats in [Hyperborean Jokul] and the boss fight against [Pole Monarch].
Lowered the difficulty of the boss fight against [Abyssal Serpent].
Optimized the background music in [Hyperborean Jokul].
Optimized the skill sound effect of [Elite Thunderous Stalker].
Optimized the firing sound effect while [Ao Bai] is dual-wielding.

Fixed an issue where players might not get hit by poison gas when getting too close to [Elite Arsonist].
Fixed an issue with the challenge event "Delay monster's death time when it is killed!" where enemies cannot be either manipulated or slowed.
Fixed abnormal texts displayed after switching language.
Fixed an issue where the model of a knocked teammate in a vault might disappear.
Fixed an issue where players might be unable to select a golden goblet upgrade provided by a peculiar chest in daily challenges.
Fixed an issue in team information panel where players might be prompted to pick up weapons equipped by other teammates.
Fixed an issue where players might perform different actions with D-pad and sticks of controllers under certain circumstances.
Fixed an issue where players cannot view detailed info in the logbook with controllers.
Fixed an issue where aim assist might lock the crosshair on stone monsters when using a controller.
Fixed incorrect weapon level of under certain circumstances.
Fixed an issue where characters might abnormally shout while going to [Jade Summit].

Fixed an issue where the projectiles of and may fail to home in on invincible enemies.

Hello everyone!

In this update, we have fixed some glitches, adjusted and optimized some gameplay-wise designs in v1.0. We truly appreciate every piece of feedback and suggestions from you after the launch of v1.0. More adjustments and optimizations are testing internally. Please offer us a little more time to polish the v1.0 into a better one. Thank you all for your support!
--Gunfire Studio
[Pole Monarch]:
Optimized visual warnings of boss's some skills to help players make full preparations.
Optimized the special effects of the vulnerable aura containers which the Pole Monarch absorbs the aura from.
Fixed the issue of frame drops in this battle.
Removed the ability of summoning monsters.
Optimized screen shake effect of some boss's skills.
Fixed an issue where the final phase could be bypassed.

*The adjustments in terms of win/loss judgement in the final phase are still under development. These adjustments will be gradually introduced in the next couple of updates. Thanks for your understanding.
Added the logbook entry of [Mutant Penguin] in [Mandrill Cavalry] .
The [Elite Mandrill Cavalry] will now stop charging if it encounters blocks.
Adjusted the DMG detection range of [Mutant Penguin] to be consistent with special effects.
Tweaked the drop rates of some scrolls.
Adjusted the challenges in [Reincarnation - Level 8].
Removed:"Monsters will rage and gain immunity to death upon taking lethal DMG. They will be defeated only when all monsters enter the rage phase."
Added:"Monsters will not leave immediately even if they have been defeated."
Rewards Adjustment: In addition to a golden goblet, a legendary scroll will also be granted after completing the challenge "Innumerable elite monsters are coming!"
Optimized: The area that can trigger challenge and the monster combinations related to the challenge event "Innumerable elite monsters are coming!" have been optimized.
