releases.displayName: Update Notes - 11/18/2021: Conquer The Jokul With Qian Sui!

items.text: Hello everyone, and thanks for waiting! More than a year of Early Access is coming to an end, because Gunfire Reborn v1.0 update is finally LIVE today!

We sincerely appreciate all devoted players who have supported and trusted us during Early Access. Without your patience and support, this would not have been possible. To all new players who've just joined us, we wish you a wonderful ride with us!

V1.0 indicates the end of Early Access and a new beginning. The current version still needs to be further improved, but we have faith in polishing the game into a better one that will satisfy you all through unceasing tweaks and updates. We will appreciate every piece of feedback and suggestions from you as always and never stop to improve the game.

To celebrate the official release of v1.0, we will run a "Launch Discount" for two weeks alongside Steam Autumn Sales. This is a great opportunity for those who haven't purchased Gunfire Reborn yet, don't miss this opportunity to join our playground with 2 million players! For players who have already owned the game, we will be honoured if you would like to recommend Gunfire Reborn to your friends!
We still need some time to improve v1.0 after the official release. Meanwhile, we will evaluate the possibility of additional DLCs, and we will let you know more when we have more to share.
Thank you for staying with us and for your warm support! See you in the game!
——Gunfire Studio

If you encounter issues such as game crashes, failure to start, etc., and you cannot use the feedback function, please send your Steam name with the detailed descriptions of the issue or screenshots to our email (qhstaff@2980.com). We will check and fix the issue as soon as possible.
Impregnable Fortress, All-rounder

The valiant Qian Sui specializes in the art of close combat, traversing the battlefield while showing off his immense strength. Being associated with water, Qian Sui is capable of summoning a Tidal Aspis to block his enemies' fierce attacks while smashing any enemy daring to stand in his way.
Unlock: 600 Soul Essence
Skills：

1.Primary Skill (E): Tidal Aspis: Summon a Tidal Aspis to block all attacks from frontal enemies for 5 seconds. When you re-cast this skill or when this skill expires, the Aspis will be retracted, dealing AoE DMG to enemies in front. When holding the Aspis, shooting becomes Striking Punch, and is enhanced to , which doubles movement distance and knocks back enemies on his way, dealing 700 normal DMG in the end.

2. Secondary Skill (Q): Striking Punch: Punch ahead with your powerful fist and cause 700 normal DMG to a small area in front. For every 1 meter of movement, +1 stack of [Fist Sensation] for 2s. Each stack of [Fist Sensation] increases Striking Punch DMG by 5%.
Swelling Tide: When retracting the Aspis, for every 1s of its remaining duration, -10% cooldown of next Tidal Aspis.
Agile Titan: +20 Max Shield, after using any hero skill, movement speed +10% for 6s
Unceasing Flow: Holding the Aspis will restore 1 use of Striking Punch every 2s
Unshielded Force: The Aspis's retracting attack also receives DMG bonus from [Fist Sensation] and related ascensions
Wild Punch: +30% Base DMG for every level-up for the weapon you currently hold.
Exclusive Spiritual Blessings：
: Reflect significant DMG back to all enemies within 10m upon taking DMG.
[Libra Warrior]: [Fist Sensation] grants extra weapon DMG which is equivalent to 100% of the bonuses to Striking Punch.
[Dominating Fist]: The stacks of [Fist Sensation] won't drop below 20.
New map: [Hyperborean Jokul]: Unlock: Once you clear Duo Fjord for the first time, the portal to Hyperborean Jokul will appear upon your next victory over either Act 3 Boss.
New peculiar chests scattered on the battlefield are awaiting heroes to unearth the treasure within.
Increased the DMG of Explosive Barrels.
Tweaked the number of monsters spawning in some vaults.
The [Bandit Tactician] in the parkour vault of [Desert Ruins] is now replaced by the environment trap [Toxin Vents].
Added symbols that indicate the type of vaults.
Guard Seal event is now only available in a vault.

New BOSS: [Pole Monarch]: The Pole Monarch, who perches on the top of Jokul, can not only strafe with a variety of weapons transformed from its Demonic aura, but also quickly approach and slash the enemy with an ice sword. In combat, the Pole Monarch can take advantage of spiritual aura to enhance itself. Only those who dare and equip with powerful arsenal can they seize the victory. Are you the brave one when facing it?
New Monsters:

[Arctic Walrus]: The vigorous and agile aborigines living on the Hyperborean Jokul. Although their behaviour is rather predictable, they overwhelm rivals with their numbers and cannot be easily ignored.
[Mandrill Cavalry]: A peculiar combo of Mutant Penguin and Snowy Mandrill. Even if one has fallen, the other can still fight relentlessly.

[Flying Saucer]: A mysterious aircraft that appears in the aurora. It can transmit stored energy to other monsters and provide them with a steady stream of life energy.: Fishing experts wandering in the Hyperborean area. They are better at manipulating deep-sea bombs than fishing.
[Kung Fu Monkey]: A Snow monkey which possesses extremely keen ears and usually appears in groups. They can survive even in extreme environments.
[Jade Fox]: A snow fox that lives in the polar region. It carries a skeleton-made gun and has a merit of agility, leaving no trace on the snow prior to a hunt.

[Mountain Guard]: A white bear that is seriously corroded by demonic aura. With the aura and its flesh fused together, their physical strength is exponentially enhanced and their nature has become ferocious.

[Elusive Stalker]: The Pole is the perfect habitat for an elusive stalker to haunt in black shadow. Being instructed by someone else, they offer nothing but a quick, clean death to anyone daring to approach Hyperborean Jokul, frightening away any outsiders.

[Thunderous Stalker]: The Pole is the perfect habitat for an elusive stalker to haunt enemies with lightning powers from the shadows. When lightning strikes and thunder roars, it indicates yet another fallen soul.
New Elite Monsters:

[Elite Thunderous Stalker]: The enigmatic elites among Thunderous Stalkers. They can conjure identical mirror images to fight together. Failing to unearth the real identity will lead you to perdition.

[Elite Mandrill Cavalry]: The battle-tested Mandrill Cavalry that shelters its rider at all costs. As a trusted mount, it also knows when to retreat and when to go all-out. Escape is an option for him in which he feels no shame, and then he waits until it's the time to strike back.
[Icy Spear]
Weapon Type: Pistol
Dual-Wield: Yes
Weapon Description: Throw ice thorns that cause continuous AoE DMG.
Weapon Skill: Return all ice thorns. After hitting the enemy, the ice thorns will deal Crit DMG to subsequent enemies while being retrieved.
+50% DMG of returning ice thorns
+50% weapon base damage on the next shot for every ice thorn returned
Unlock: Kill 2 times
[Deafening Mortar]
Weapon Type: Launcher
Dual-Wield: Yes
Weapon Description: Fire a series of explosive barrages at close range
Weapon Skill: Fire three mortar shells after a brief charge.
Exclusive Inscription: There is a 20% chance to consume 0 ammo upon shooting.
Unlock: Kill [Arrogant Lobster] 5 times.
Manual reloading grants your next magazine +10% DMG if you achieve at least 40% accuracy with the current magazine.
Each hit gains +3% weapon base DMG for 5s (up to 15 stacks), but you will lose 1 stack on a miss.
(Gemini) Killing an enemy with the held weapon increases the base DMG of the next shot from the off-hand weapon by 50%. (Up to 10 shots will be affected.)
Exclusive Inscription: +0.5x CritX for every crit hit within 2s of zooming in (up to +10.0x).
"Explosion AoE -50%; RoF and Reload Speed +40%.”->“Explosion AoE -20%; RoF and Reload Speed +40%.”
“25% chance to recover 50% ammo to the magazine when you kill an enemy.”->“30% chance to recover 50% ammo to the magazine when you kill an enemy.”
“When scope is on, shots consume no ammo for 2s and +50% RoF for the duration.”->“When scope is on, shots consume no ammo for 2s.”
“+10% Lucky Shot Chance but -30% Accuracy briefly on each kill. (Up to 10 stacks)”->“+10% Lucky Shot Chance but -10% Accuracy briefly on each kill. (Up to 10 stacks)”
[Fire Tower]
Reduced weapon base DMG（750->700）
Lowered the elemental effect chance of the normal attack in the second phase. （100%->50%）
[Thunder Storm]
Optimized the behaviour of the weapon skill.
Removed Inscription: "Projectiles+0.3, Magazine Capacity -50%.”
Changed the unlock requirement of from: "Kill [Rogue Villain] 40 times with Corrosion DMG." to "Kill [Rogue Villain] 30 times with Corrosion DMG."

Changed the unlock requirement of from: "Kill [Arrogant Lobster] 60 times with Fire DMG." to "Kill [Arrogant Lobster] 40 times with Fire DMG.": (*Players who have met the required number of defeats but haven't unlocked will need to kill [Arrogant Lobster] one more time with Fire DMG to unlock it.)
Inscriptions that increase RoF will no longer be available on weapons that need charging.
Optimized the crosshair of some weapons

Optimized the buffer sequence of melee weapons and hero/weapon skills. Now, if players cast the second skill while the first skill is casting, then the subsequent counterpart will auto-cast right after the first skill.
Optimized the interaction behaviour when using a controller: A cursor will now appear when players are moving a stick.
Tweaked the strength of aim assist.
Added Reincarnation LEVEL 8: In this difficulty, players will encounter a plethora of formidable room challenges where only those cunning, skillful and daring enough will win. Please be careful!
Adjusted the amount of Soul Essence needed to refresh spiritual blessings in [Reincarnation - Longling Tomb - Entrance]
[Unstoppable Momentum] (Qing Yan's Exclusive)
Old: +100% base DMG for the next leap when you hit an enemy with a leap (up to 5 stacks). Removes all stacks on a miss.
New: +100% base DMG for the next leap when you hit an enemy with a leap (up to 10 stacks). Removes all stacks on a miss.
[Atomic Bomb] (Ao Bai's Exclusive)
Old: When using a secondary skill, there is a 30% chance to toss all remaining grenades without consuming uses. +50% Explosive Grenade DMG for 3s (stackable) every time any grenade deals DMG.
New: When using a secondary skill, there is a 30% chance to toss all remaining grenades without consuming uses. +50% Explosive Grenade DMG for 1s (stackable) every time any grenade deals DMG.
[Occult Booster]
Price adjustment: from 30 Soul Essence to 90（30->90）
[Enhanced-Devil's Covenant]: +50% all copper gained.
[Enhanced-Propulsion Device]: Dash has 3 charges and its distance is increased by 3m.
[Enhanced-Elite Assassin]: +10% DMG Dealt for each elite or boss you've killed in the entire run.
[Enhanced-Backup Shield]: Recover 100% Shield/Armor instantly when Shield/Armor fully depletes. (Cooldown: 5s)
[Enhanced-Airbag]Recover 100% HP instantly when Shield/Armor fully depletes.
[Enhanced-Against the Flow]: Recover 15% ammo to the magazine every second for 4s after dealing DMG to an enemy.
[Enhanced-Untold Effort]: When using the Secondary Skill, there is a 50% chance not to consume any use and another 50% chance to deal +100% total DMG.
[Enhanced-Merciless Combo]：+10% weapon DMG for 2s whenever hitting the enemy (Can be stacked up to 100 times).
[Enhanced-Fast-Loader]: Fill the magazine instantly after swapping weapons. +30% Lucky Shot Chance (Gradually decreases to 0% over 3s), and your first 3 shots won't consume ammo.
[Enhanced-Skateboarder]Fill the magazine instantly after dashing, and shooting won't consume ammo for the next 2s.
[Enhanced-Safety Measures]: Dashing after being injured recovers total HP by 50% of the DMG taken within 2s.
[Enhanced-Mutual Respect]: Grants +15% weapon DMG and -5% DMG taken for every [Mutual Respect] your team owns.

[Enhanced-Generosity]: Increase the amount of HP recovered from buns by 50%. When you pick up/obtain a bun, all teammates receive 25% of the HP recovered; you receive 25% of HP recovered by teammates when they pick up/obtain buns.

[Enhanced-Capacity Overdraft]: The secondary skill can still be used when the number of uses is insufficient, but each use will cause considerable DMG to you and grant +30% skill DMG for 5s. (Up to 5 stacks)

[Enhanced-Energy Sandals]： Store 12 points of energy for each Dash, and there's a 33% chance to fully replenish energy points upon storing. Consume all energy points when using a secondary skill with +1% skill DMG for each energy point consumed. (Up to 600 points of energy can be stored.)

[Enhanced-Skill Booster]: Store 2 points of energy for each Crit, and there's a 33% chance to fully replenish energy points upon storing. Consume all energy points when using a secondary skill with +1% skill DMG for each energy point consumed. (Up to 500 points of energy can be stored.)
[Enhanced-Tactical Reload]: -100% DMG taken and +30% movement speed while reloading
[Enhanced-Resilient Life]: Restore 3% HP per second for 5 seconds whenever you take DMG. (Up to 5 stacks)
New Legendary Scrolls：
[Elemental Magazine]: Unlock: Default: Rarity: Legendary: Effect: Deals an additional 50% DMG when weapon DMG causes an elemental effect.
[Reasonable Luck]: Unlock: Default: Rarity: Legendary: Effect: +80% Lucky Shot Chance, but total Lucky Shot Chance won't exceed 150%.
[Rich's Privileges]: Unlock： Default: Rarity： Legendary: Effect： Deal additional skill DMG based on current copper you own when your skill does DMG. (Up to 1 time per enemy every 3s.)
[Overwhelming Shield]: Unlock： Default: Rarity： Legendary: Effect： Shield Recovery won't be interrupted when your Shield is below 50%.
New rare scrolls：
[Fight for Immortality]: Unlock： Kill [Elite Beetle] 5 times: Rarity： Rare: Effect： Upon taking DMG, gain additional max Shield/Armor for 12s, equivalent to the DMG received. (CD: 45s)

[Hidden Transaction]: Unlock： Kill [Dragon Qian] 3 times on elite or higher difficulty.: Rarity： Rare: Effect： There's a 33% chance to enhance a weapon by +1 extra level when enhancing your weapons at a craftsman.
[Terrific Crossfire]: Unlock： Kill [Venomous Lizard] 20 times on elite or higher difficulty.: Rarity： Rare: Effect： -1s Primary Skill CD upon casting a secondary skill.
[Surprise Bonus]: Unlock： Kill [Elite Monk] 3 times.: Rarity： Rare: Effect： There's a 15% chance to double DMG dealt for any skill.
New normal scrolls：
[Sucker Punch]: Unlock： Kill [Abyssal Serpent] 3 times.: Rarity： Normal: Effect： +35% Skill DMG when your skill hits an enemy with more than 70% HP.
[Enduring Caster]: Unlock： Kill [Elite Kappa] 3 times.: Rarity： Normal: Effect：+1% Skill DMG for every 5 total HP (HP + Shield/Armor) you currently have.
[Vindictive Nature]: Unlock： Kill [Lightning Lizard] 20 times on elite or higher difficulty.: Rarity： Normal: Effect： +40% Weapon and Skill DMG for 10s upon being hit or taking DMG.
Scroll Balancing Changes：
1.[Coin Shot]
Old： Consumes 2 copper on hit with +60% weapon DMG. (Can't be triggered when you don't have any copper). Killing an enemy in 5 hits refunds all copper spent on the enemy.
New: +30% Lucky Shot Chance by consuming 2 copper when you land a shot. Copper spent will be refunded if you successfully trigger a Lucky Shot.
Note: Multi-projectile weapons now only consume copper once.
2. [Fountain of Life]
Old: Recover 1 HP whenever picking up copper or ammo.
New: When picking up copper or ammo, recover 1HP, or increase max HP by 1 for 10s if HP is full.
Adjusted the scroll drop rates per rarity tier on each difficulty.
Qian Sui's Win： Win a game as Qian Sui.
Absolute Defense： Block attacks 500 times in total with Tidal Aspis.
Breaking Dawn： Defeat Pole Monarch for the first time.
Hold Your Breath： When the Pole Monarch attempts to shatter the spiritual jade, take it down with only 3s remaining before his charging process is finished.
Fully in Control： Complete any Reincarnation level without purchasing any spiritual blessing.
Efficient Utilization： Recycle an item.
Diligence and Thrift： Obtain a total of 10,000 copper by recycling items.
Thrifty Expert： Obtain 1,000 copper by recycling items in a single run.
New daily challenge effects：
Theme [Unavoidable Confrontation]：
[Narrow Escape]： There is a 2% chance to drop a spiritual gem upon each kill only when you cannot revive yourself, which grants you another chance to self revive.
[Demonic Force]： For every 4s an enemy survives, its attack interval will be decreased by 10% (up to -30%).
Theme [Economic Pressure]：
[Venture for Wealth]：Gain 600 copper each time you refresh any golden goblet.
Theme [Unpredictable Fortune]：
[Fate Changer]: You can reroll up to 5 non-cursed scrolls after finishing any stage.
[Appointed Luck]: Possible scroll drops are limited to [Mysterious Chest] and [Effective Split].
Theme [Crystal Seeker]：
[No Dodge]： Connected enemies deal an additional +50% total DMG to players, but they receive -70% movement speed and cannot evade.
Theme [Elite Sniper]：
[Hydrated Asylum]： A appears and protects a random monster every 6s, granting them permanent immunity to all DMG until the is killed. ( can only be eliminated by weapons.)
Changed daily challenge description: Weapons, scrolls, achievements and logbook entries can't be unlocked in this mode.

Added rewards by beating daily challenge boss: First boss kill of the day grants 100 soul essence, and 30 for each subsequent kill. Bonus rewards will be refreshed alongside the theme at 05:00 (GMT+8) every day.

Hello everyone!

In this update, we have added some occult scrolls and adjusted the effects of some spiritual blessings and scrolls. In addition, we have adjusted the method of obtaining a spiritual blessing in [Reincarnation - Longling Tomb - Entrance] (Players can consume a few soul essences to reroll available spiritual blessings). We are still working on tweaking difficulty, and we are grateful for your invaluable feedback.

It has been over a year since Gunfire Reborn's Early Access on Steam, and we humbly thank you all for your continuous support and love. We cannot achieve what we have accomplished without your dedicated feedback and suggestions.

We plan to release the 1.0 version in mid-November. With more content integrated into the game and increasing development costs, we have to tweak the price by a moderate increase in mid-October. We will publish another official price-increase announcement and v1.0 update preview when it's about time to do so.
Why price increase before the v1.0 launch?

Due to restrictions of Steam, we may not offer a "Launch Discount" if we raise the price at the v1.0 launch. Therefore, we have decided to adjust the price in advance so that we can provide a Launch Discount for those who haven't purchased the game.

items.text: Hello, everyone~

In this update, we have added several spiritual blessings and enhanced occult scrolls, and tweaked the difficulty of the boss [Abyssal Serpent]. Meanwhile, we’ve also improved the game experience when using controllers. The optimization of controllers is a long-term mission for us and we will spare no effort to further polish the controller way to play the game. Thank you for your support and feedback!
——Gunfire Studio, Duoyi

If you encounter issues such as game crashes, failure to start, etc., and you cannot use the feedback function, please send your Steam name with detailed description of the issue or screenshots to our email (qhstaff@2980.com). We will check and fix the issue as soon as possible.
Tweaked the effect of the talent [Golden Touch], players can now only recycle their own drops (weapons and scrolls)
The minimum time until death is decreased from 6s to 2s
Any soul essence spent will be refunded if a player abandons their adventure in [Longling Tomb-Entrance]
The accumulated stacks will be carried over when occult scrolls that can stack bonus are replaced with their respective enhanced version

For spiritual blessings that have their effects applied to all squad members such as [Royal Guard], if one of the teammates has purchased these spiritual blessings, other teammates will no longer be capable of buying them. Other [Spiritual Remnants] in later stages will no longer offer the same spiritual blessing(s).

releases.displayName: The First Female Hero [Tao] Meets You in the Summer Version - 6/18 Update notes

items.text: Hello Everyone!
The 2021 summer version meets you as scheduled.

In this update, we've introduced a new hero (the first female hero:), new weapons, a new random boss, revamped talent system, new occult scrolls, reincarnation difficulty, and more. We wish you would enjoy them! If you encounter any issues or have any suggestions, please feel free to contact us. We will value your opinions and try our best to optimize the game based on your feedback.

In addition, we have good news to share: Gunfire Reborn has sold over 1.5 million copies! We will continue our work and present you with more awesome content in this winter. Meanwhile, we prepare an early access 1st anniversary avatar frame for you. Players who own Gunfire Reborn before July 9, 2021 will get this avatar frame for free. Thank you all for your love and support!

Finally, the fourth stage that many players are looking forward to is under development. As we all know, this part of work requires a lot of time and resources. We will do our best to introduce the fourth stage in 1.0 version as planned. Please stay tuned~

Gunfire Studio, Duoyi: *If you encounter issues such as game crashes, failure to start, etc., and you cannot use the feedback function, please send your Steam name with detailed description of the issue or screenshots to our email (qhstaff@2980.com). We will check and fix the issue as soon as possible.*

Introduction: Tao, who is a master in the art of sword control, is keen to manipulate her royal flying sword to strike all foes. Meanwhile, she can condense her energy into petals, dealing hidden injuries against enemies with her [Fatal Bloom]
Unlock Requirement:Spend 400 soul essences

Skills: 1.Primary Skill (E): Swords Out: Unsheathe multiple flying swords, each dealing 200 DMG. The number of flying swords is determined by the stacks of [Blade Heart]. Each stack can summon 3 flying swords. releases.displayName: Summer Major Update Preview & Early Access 1-year Anniversary Thank-you letter

items.text: With summer just around the corner, the scheduled 2021 Summer Major Update is soon to be available free to all players. Based on the current development progress, we decide to release the major update on Jun. 18th.

The new features in this major update include: a long-anticipated heroine, a new random boss in Act 3, new weapons and adjustments to some legacy weapons, new occult scrolls and Talent 2.0. We're still tweaking and adjusting the new content, especially the new talent system. As of now, the current version of the newly-introduced features are still yet to meet our quality standard. With that being said, we will speed up the development process and strive to present the most satisfactory content as possible.

This month marks the first anniversary of the Early Access release of Gunfire Reborn. Looking back on the past year, we have gone through many ups and downs together, and the most invaluable gift we have received along the way is the devoted support and love from over 1-million players worldwide. This is the most effective catalyst for us to continue this wild ride with you. Thank you again for your feedback and love! We’ll keep on improving the game and delivering more exciting content in the future.
See you in mid-June!

releases.displayName: Update Notes - 4/29/2021: Adjustments on Qing Yan, Ao Bai, weapons & scrolls

items.text: Hello everyone!

In this update, we have adjusted some Qing Yan’s and Ao Bai’s ascensions, added a new daily challenge theme, and optimized Wind God and some occult scrolls. Meanwhile, we are still looking forward to your feedback and suggestions. Our main focus is to develop new content as usual, so we may need more time to fix bugs and optimize the game. The next major update, which includes a new hero, a new boss, new weapons and more, will be released this summer. Please stay tuned.

*If you encounter issues such as game crashes, failure to start, etc., and you cannot use the feedback function, please send your Steam name with detailed description of the issue or screenshots to our email (qhstaff@2980.com). We will check and fix the issue as soon as possible.*

releases.displayName: Celebrate Lunar New Year with New Hero!——1/29 Update notes

items.text: Hello everyone!

The first major update in 2021 finally meets with everyone. In addition to the new hero and new boss, the long-awaited weapon type- melee weapon is also introduced in this update. Hope you will enjoy it! Meanwhile, we will continue to optimize game contents. We will appreciate if you can give us some feedback and suggestions.
We have been working on the new main level that many players are looking forward to, but we still need more time to develop. Please be patient and stay tuned!
Thank you for your continued support and love. Hope you all have fun!

*If you encounter issues such as game crashes, failure to start, etc., and you cannot use the feedback function, please send your Steam name with detailed description of the issue or screenshots to our email (qhstaff@2980.com). We will check and fix the issue as soon as possible.*

Introduction: Lei Luo, who is born with thunder tattoos, can easily manipulate thunder to hit enemies. Through continuous training, he can integrate his talents with firearm skills to make an amazing shot.
Unlock Requirement:Talent level reaches 55

Lei Luo's Skills: 1.Primary Skill (E): Fatal Current: Activate the electric current hidden under Lei Luo's tattoos to increase his movement speed by 30% and skill damage by 50% for 5 seconds. During this period, hitting any enemy will end the bonus state and convert the shot into Thunderstrike which deals 200% extra damage and summons a thunder with 800 lightning damage after the hit.: 2.Secondary Skill (Q): Chain Lightning: Launch a lightning bolt at the enemy to deal 500 lightning damage. After hitting the target, the lightning bolt will automatically bounce to another nearby enemy, up to 2 times.

Exclusive Talents: 1.Sniper: Elite monsters/bosses will drop an extra sniper rifle: 2.Gifted Man: You can choose a random extra talent after starting the adventure: 3.Thunderborn: Fatal Current lasts for 1 more second, and -2 seconds cooldown time: 4.Re-Energized: When the shield is broken, restore 50% number of uses of the secondary skill: 5.Surging Crit: When using a sniper rifle, there is a 50% chance of triggering a Crit Hit which has 70% CritX of the current weapon even if you miss weaknesses
New Weapons:
Weapon Type: melee weapon
Weapon Skill: thrust forward for 5 times after a short charge (release at right time, or the charge will be interrupted)(Does not apply to Dual-wield)
Exclusive Inscription: When using weapon skill, DMG will be increased with the number of the hit by the thrust
Unlock Requirement: Kill Foot Soldier 60 times
Weapon Type: sniper rifle
Weapon Skill: Once hit the target, three arrows will be split to the enemy behind the target (Does not apply to Dual-wield)
Exclusive Inscription: All split arrows will go after the same target
Unlock Requirement: Kill Catfish Man 20 times

Add three weapon inscriptions (only work on melee weapons): (1)50% chance to deal DMG twice if there is only 1 enemy within 3m: (2)After killing the enemy, +30% movement speed for 5s and +100% Lucky Shot chance for next hit: (3)+50% weapon DMG if there are more than 1 enemy within 5m
Optimized the size of crosshair when Golden Bow is fully drawn.
New BOSS:

Wind is its wing so it can fly. In ancient tales, Wind God can carry the sand with wind to ramp across the desert. Usually people can only see the tornado and sandstorm rather than the true face of Wind God so they think this is nonsense.
Unlock Requirement：Kill Ichthyosaurus Offspring 5 times
New Elite Monster:
Kappa, who has been cultivated for many years, now can not only summon more magical balls but also be able to teleport.
Optimized hitbox detection of Golem so that it’s easier to hit weak points when Golem is leaning.
2 Elite Vaults added in Longling Tomb

Expanded the route of Longling Tomb-Stage 4
1 new Guard Seal level added in Anxi Desert
2 new secure-the-area levels and 2 new Guard Seal levels added in Duo Fjord
Expanded the route of Duo Fjord-Stage 1, Duo Fjord-Stage2 and Duo Fjord-Stage 3
Victory of Lei Luo：Complete a run with Lei Luo
Son of Thunder：Use Fatal Current for more than 1000 seconds
Philanthropist：Share 100 items in total
Lucky Draw：Obtain a weapon with two or more exclusive inscriptions
Professional Athlete：Complete a run on normal difficulty in 30 minutes
Sports Car：Complete a run on elite difficulty in 30 minutes
Sky is the Limit：Complete a run on nightmare difficulty in 30 minutes
Fresh Start：Complete one Daily Challenge
Master of Daily Challenge：Complete 5 unique Daily Challenges
Legendary Shot：Single attack deals more than 300,000 DMG
Advanced Weapon：Carry a weapon which is Lv.12+
Raging Winds：Kill Wind God for the first time
Everlasting Martyr：Kill Golem for the first time
New theme:Elite Sniper

Modified 1 additional special effect in the daily challenge theme: Unavoidable Confrontation: Original: +30% Movement Speed for 2 seconds whenever killing enemies with Crit Hit.: New: +10% Movement Speed for 3 seconds whenever dealing Crit Hit. (Can be stacked, capping at 50%)

1 new additional special effect added in the daily challenge theme: Unavoidable Confrontation: New: Monster has 20% chance to equip with Immunization Shield.: Immunization Shield: becomes invulnerable to damage and manipulation for a short time when injured

1 additional special effect added in the daily challenge theme: Economy Pressure: New: Items sold by the peddler are upgraded: Weapons: Weapon level +2; Occult scrolls: Buy one get one free; Buns: Recover full HP. The craftsman's ability: weapon level +2 upon each enhancement.

1 new additional special effect added in the daily challenge theme: Vlad’s Dream: New: DMG taken would deduct corresponding HP in the form of bleeding for 4s, killing an enemy would stop bleeding immediately.

Modified 1 additional special effect in the daily challenge theme: Unpredictable Fortune: Original: +50% DMG Dealt for each Legendary Occult Scroll you own: New: When the numbers of legendary occult scrolls and cursed occult scrolls you own are different, +30% Lucky Shot Chance for each difference.
1 new additional special effect added in the daily challenge theme: Unpredictable Fortune: New: Picking up a lengedary scroll will grant you a random non-cursed scroll

items.text: Hello everyone!

In this update, the new gameplay mode “Daily Challenge” and the new Vault “Stone Monsters” are arriving. In addition, there are new weapons such as Thunder Storm and Bloody Drill, and new elite monsters.Meanwhile, we plan to participate “Best Game You Suck At” in the Steam Awards 2020. Please come and vote for us!

The gameplay themes of the Daily Challenge are still optimizing and updating. We welcome and will be truly grateful if you can provide new ideas and suggestions. The birth of this gameplay mode benefited from the inspiration given to us by our enthusiastic players. Thank you for your continued support to Gunfire Reborn!

In order to devote more energy to the development of the full release version (the weekly updates will consume a lot of our development time), we will update less frequently. Moreover, the update roadmap will be released in mid-December. Please stay tuned! (We will not delay anymore this time:))

*If you encounter issues such as game crashes, failure to start, etc., and you cannot use the feedback function, please send your Steam name with detailed description of the issue or screenshots to our email (qhstaff@2980.com). We will check and fix the issue as soon as possible.*
Daily Challenge: Short and exciting gameplay mode with randomly refreshed themes every day!: Unlock: Talent reaches level 35

New weapons：: Thunder Storm: Shoot a lightning ray that can penetrate the enemy.: Weapon Skill: Fire a lightning ball that can be detonated by the lightning ray. It will disable enemy's shield and deal direct damage on hit.: Exclusive Inscription: +100% radius for weapon skill's lightning ball and +100% DMG for its detonation.: Unlock: Kill [Elite Bandit Hermit] once.: Bloody Drill：Hits on enemy will cause bleeding, and the effect is stackable.: Bleeding: Constantly decrease HP regardless of shield and armor.: Exclusive Inscription: Hits on bleeding enemy can deal +50% damage.: Exclusive Inscription: The farther the enemy you hits, the higher the bleeding damage.: Unlock: Kill [Elite Yaksha] twice.
Optimized the experience of using charged weapons during dual-wield.

New Occult Scrolls：: Lone Ranger: Quality：Rare: Effect：When there are no monsters around you within 12 meters, +1 layer of status for every 0.5 seconds (up to 20 layers). On the contrary, -1 layer of status for every 0.5 seconds. +1 Lucky shot chance for each layer, and +5% extra Lucky shot chance when you reach 20 layers: Unlock：Kill [Rogue Henchman] 10 times: Dormant Bullet: Quality：Rare: Effect：The fewer bullets the magazine remains, the higher the weapon damage is, up to 75% increase in weapon damage: Unlock：Kill [Bandit Retainer] 20 times

Occult Scrolls Rework：: Thunder Screen：Increased elemental effect chance, but lowered the initial damage. Damage is now affected by Shield/Armor, HP and Skill Damage.: Thorny Carapace：Increased elemental effect chance, but lowered the initial damage. Damage is now affected by Shield/Armor, HP and Skill Damage.: Field Support：The range of buff is now within 15 meters (up from 12 meters): Deadly Counter：Can now be triggered by self-damage (Self-damage caused by "Bloody Ammo" & "Capacity Overdraft" can also trigger this occult scroll.): Energy Sandals：Each dash now stores 12 points of energy (up from 5 points). Maximum points of energy increased to 600 points (from 500 points): Skill Booster：Store 2 points of energy (up from 1 point) for each crit.: Snow Boots：Now immune to Slow debuff caused by "Heavy Shield": Flame Shard：: Previous：Gain immunity to Fire DMG for 2s after receiving Fire DMG, but take 50% extra Lightning DMG and Corrosion DMG.: Now： Fire damage +25%, and immune to the negative effects of burning effect. The additive effect is doubled while in burning effect.: Corrosion Shard：: Previous：Gain immunity to Corrosion DMG for 2s after receiving Corrosion DMG, but take 50% extra Fire DMG and Lightning DMG.: Now：Corrosion damage +25%, and immune to the negative effects of decay effect. The additive effect is doubled while in decay effect.: Lightning Shard：: Previous：Gain immunity to Lightning DMG for 2s after receiving Lightning DMG, but take 50% extra Fire DMG and Corrosion DMG.: Now：Lightning damage +25%, and immune to the negative effects of shock effect. The additive effect is doubled while in shock effect.
New Elite Monster：Elite Bandit Hermit: A leader among bandits liked to summon coyotes to attack passing caravans.

Boss Balance Changes：Golem: Reduced damage caused by Golem.: Reduced total HP of Golem.: Reduced the number of tracking stones summoned by Golem.: Reduced damage radius of Golem's fists.: Increased the interval between Golem's two fists, thus lowered the difficulty of avoiding attack.: When playing as Qing Yan, melee skills can now deal damage on Golem.

Rework , , and enhanced monster: A fire ball will be periodically spawned above to attack players. However, players can break it by shooting when it is flying toward them: Deal lightning damage to any players within 15m periodically: A self-explosive corrosive ball will be periodically spawned above (breakable when spawning), explosion will create an area which can deal persistent corrosive damage to players within 10m
New Level:Stone Monster: Lots of stone monsters show up in the vault.Watch out not to hit them, or they will be awaken and attack you.
New Room Challenge: Traps will be spawned beneath the hero once in a while
Anxi Desert-Stage 3: Add two new routes
Duo Fjord-Stage 2: Add one new route
Duo Fjord-Stage 3: Add one new route
Anxi Desert's Vault-Desert Ruins: Add one new route

releases.displayName: New melee hero Qing Yan & new weapons are available - 08/20 Update Announcement

items.text: Hello everyone!
The long-awaited new hero is finally here! New weapons, new monsters and new difficulty have also been updated. Hope you will enjoy them!

At present we are still in Early Access, especially the new hero and the new difficulty are still in the adjustment period. We need your suggestions and feedback to help us polish the game. Thank you for your support!

*If you encounter issues such as game crashes, failure to start, etc., and you cannot use the feedback function, please send your Steam name with detailed description of the issue or screenshots to our email (qhstaff@2980.com). We will check and fix the issue as soon as possible.*

Hero Introduction: Unlike Crown Prince and Ao Bai, Qing Yan is a melee hero who uses armor as defense - this means that it does not have a self-recovering shield like Crown Prince or Ao Bai, and you have to hit or kill the enemy in close range to restore the armor. Obviously, this is not a hero that can be easily played, but it is indeed an unique hero.: So, forget Crown Prince and Ao Bai, and try out this Kungfu Master - Qing Yan
Unlock Qing Yan：Level 40
Qing Yan's Skills:
Primary Skill（E）：Leap: Qing Yan leaps forward with a hard kick, dealing damage to all enemies within 7m. Each hit can recover armor for Qing Yan
Secondary Skill（Q）：Cleave: Qing Yan cleaves recklessly and deals damage to the enemies within a fan-shape
Exclusive Talent:
Continuous Leap: If leap doesn't hit the target, decrease 50% cooldown time
Survival Enhancement：HP+20，Armor+20
Charged Shooting：Restore 1 Armor Point whenever your shot hits the enemy (Up to 6 points per second)
Cleave Reinforcement：Cleave DMG +300
Emergency Defense：When Armor reaches 0, immune to Normal DMG for 2s (The effect can activate again whenever the Armor has been fully charged)
Adjust the elite difficulty and some gameplay mechanisms. The recommended entry level for elite difficulty is level 40

Open nightmare difficulty. The recommended entry level for nightmare difficulty is level 80: * Nightmare difficulty is currently in the testing stage. If you encounter issues during the experience or have suggestions, you can use the built-in ESC "feedback" function to contact us. We will optimize the nightmare difficulty in the near future, please give us a little more time.*

New Weapon：Sting: Sting's fire mode will automatically rotate between three-shot, two-shot and single-shot. In single-shot mode, hitting enemies can cause explosion and break the armor of normal enemies
New Weapon：Talisman: Talisman is a weapon that can switch between different elements and auto-lock the weakness of the enemy

New Monster：Umbrella Spirit: Demonic Umbrella is a monster who loves to fly at low altitude, and you can hardly detect it in the night of Duo Fjord. Once it attacks you, you will be in a very dangerous circumstance
New Elite Monster：Elite Corrupt Monk: Powerful Monk who can even create its own mirror image with demonic aura and summon perilous Large Lantern Spirit
Monster Adjustment: Slightly decrease the damage of Bandit Retainer

Hello everyone!

In this update, we have added 2 new weapons, 5 new Occult Scrolls, 3 new elite monsters, and updated some main-line levels and Vault. We are appreciative if you can give us some feedback and suggestions so that we can continue the optimization.

The third hero is already in the internal testing phase and is expected to be available soon. In addition, the design of New Game Plus is currently under preparation. Please give us more time to develop it. Thank you for your support.

*If you encounter issues such as game crashes, flashbacks, or unable to start, and you cannot use the feedback function, you can send us an email (email address: qhstaff@2980.com) with your Steam name and specific description/screenshot of the issue. We will check the issue as soon as possible.*

Occult Scroll：: Coins of Life：Won't die when taking lethal damage. Costs 100% copper coins to be immune to current damage and all incoming damage for the next 3 seconds. Scroll is destroyed once the effect is triggered: Thunder Screen：Deals 400 Lightning DMG to surrounding enemies within 10 meters when the shield is broken: Fish or Bear Paw：Weapon DMG -50%, but each attack deals the damage twice: Long Shot：Increase weapon DMG when hitting the enemy away from you.
